title: SpatialUQ: Post-Hoc Uncertainty Quantification from Spatial Consistency in Black-Box Vision Models
title_zh: SpatialUQ: 从黑盒视觉模型的空间一致性进行后验不确定性量化

paragraphs.en: SpatialUQ: Post-Hoc Uncertainty Quantification from Spatial Consistency in Black-Box Vision Models
paragraphs.zh: SpatialUQ：基于黑箱视觉模型中空间一致性的事后不确定性量化

paragraphs.en: Clinical vision models are often deployed as frozen black boxes with no access to internals, retraining, or ground truth at inference time. We introduce SpatialUQ , a post-hoc uncertainty method using only output probabilities. It measures the Jensen-Shannon divergence between the global prediction and the mean of five fixed spatial crops in six deterministic forward passes. The premise is simple, trustworthy predictions are spatially consistent. On NIH ChestX-ray14 (DenseNet-121, N = 25,596 N{=}25{,}596 ), our Multicrop Uncertainty Score (MUS) reaches 0.784 0.784 failure-detection AUC versus 0.664 0.664 for MC-Dropout ( p < 10 − 6 p{<}10^{-6} ) at one-fifth the compute, with native calibration ( SCE = 0.049 \text{SCE}{=}0.049 vs. 0.127 0.127 for ℓ 1 \ell_{1} ), the best-calibrated among methods above 0.78 AUC. A supervised fusion of MUS with entropy, confidence, and ℓ 1 \ell_{1} reaches 0.832 0.832 , outperforming a five-member ensemble ( 0.813 0.813 ). MUS scales with model quality, reaching 0.899 0.899 with BiomedCLIP ( ρ = 0.846 \rho=0.846 ), while this relationship remains meaningful in-distribution ( ρ = 0.523 \rho=0.523 ) but breaks down under severe distribution shift (VinBigData, ρ = 0.027 \rho=0.027 ). MUS is well-suited to diffuse findings but is less dependable for small focal lesions such as nodules. Code and experimental materials are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/kawsher11/SpatialUQ .
paragraphs.zh: 临床视觉模型通常以“冻结黑箱”的形式部署，在推理阶段无法访问其内部机制、进行重新训练或获取真实标签。 我们提出了 SpatialUQ，一种仅使用输出概率的后续不确定性评估方法。 该方法通过六次确定性前向传播，测量全局预测与五个固定空间裁剪区域均值之间的詹森-香农散度。 其基本假设很简单：可信的预测在空间上应当具有一致性。 在 NIH ChestX-ray14（DenseNet-121，N = 25,596）数据集上，我们的多裁剪不确定性得分（MUS）在仅消耗五分之一计算量的情况下，实现了 0.784 的故障检测 AUC，而 MC-Dropout 仅为 0.664（p < 10⁻⁶），同时具备原生校准能力（SCE = 0.049，对比 ℓ₁ 的 0.127），在 AUC 高于 0.78 的方法中校准效果最佳。 将 MUS 与熵、置信度和 ℓ₁ 进行监督融合后，AUC 达到 0.832，优于由五个模型组成的集成方法（0.813）。 MUS 的效能随模型质量提升而增强：使用 BiomedCLIP 时可达 0.899（ρ = 0.846）；尽管在分布内该相关性依然显著（ρ = 0.523），但在严重分布偏移（VinBigData，ρ = 0.027）的情况下则失效。 MUS 对弥漫性病变的识别效果良好，但对于结节等小型局灶性病变则可靠性较低。 代码及实验材料可在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/kawsher11/SpatialUQ 公开获取。

paragraphs.en: Deep neural networks can fail silently on out-of-distribution inputs ( Amodei et al., 2016 ; Hendrycks and Dietterich, 2019 ) , posing patient-safety risks in medical imaging where confident errors are consequential ( Leibig et al., 2017 ; Kendall and Gal, 2017 ) . Reliable deployment therefore requires inference-time failure detection without ground truth. However, frozen black-box classifiers exclude many existing UQ approaches. Bayesian methods such as MC-Dropout ( Gal and Ghahramani, 2016 ) require training-time modifications, ensembles ( Lakshminarayanan et al., 2017 ) and TTA ( Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ) add substantial compute, while post-hoc methods such as DDU ( Mukhoti et al., 2023 ) , Mahalanobis ( Lee et al., 2018 ) , energy ( Liu et al., 2020 ) , ODIN ( Liang et al., 2017 ) , and conformal prediction ( Angelopoulos and Bates, 2023 ) require model internals, feature distributions, or calibration data. Recent consistency-based ( Khan and Fu, 2024 ) and augmentation-sensitivity ( Shu et al., 2026 ) methods operate in related settings but rely on linguistic or photometric perturbations, leaving geometric evidence largely unexplored.
paragraphs.zh: 深度神经网络可能对分布外输入产生静默失效（Amodei 等人，2016；Hendrycks 和 Dietterich，2019），在医疗成像领域，这种自信的错误可能导致严重后果，从而给患者安全带来风险（Leibig 等人，2017；Kendall 和 Gal，2017）。 因此，可靠的部署需要在没有真实标签的情况下，在推理阶段检测出失效。 然而，冻结的黑箱分类器排除了许多现有的不确定性量化方法。 贝叶斯方法（如 MC-Dropout（Gal 和 Ghahramani，2016））需要训练阶段的修改；集成方法（Lakshminarayanan 等人，2017）和 TTA（Krizhevsky 等人，2012）则会大幅增加计算量；而事后方法（如 DDU（Mukhoti 等人，2023）、Mahalanobis（Lee 等人，2018）、能量方法（Liu 等人，2020）、ODIN（Liang 等人，2017）和符合性预测（Angelopoulos 和 Bates，2023））则需要模型内部信息、特征分布或校准数据。 近期的基于一致性（Khan 和 Fu，2024）和增强敏感性（Shu 等人，2026）的方法虽然在相关领域有所应用，但它们依赖于语言或光度扰动，而几何证据在很大程度上仍未被探索。

paragraphs.en: We propose SpatialUQ grounded on a single premise: a reliable model produces spatially consistent predictions across an image and its sub-regions. Well-localized features create strong agreement between global and crop-level predictions. On the other hand, distributional mismatch, low image quality, or atypical presentations make them diverge. We measure this divergence as the Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD) between the global prediction and the mean of five fixed spatial crops, in six deterministic forward passes. This geometric signal needs no internals, sampling, or reference data, and differs fundamentally from TTA ( Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ; Wang et al., 2019 ) (Lemma 1 ; Section 5.4.1 ). A supervised logistic fusion of MUS with entropy, confidence, and ℓ 1 \ell_{1} improves failure detection further, except under severe shift where MC-Dropout remains preferable.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了基于单一前提的 SpatialUQ：一个可靠的模型会在整张图像及其子区域中生成空间上一致的预测。 定位准确的特征会使全局预测与裁剪级预测之间产生高度一致的结果。 另一方面，分布不匹配、图像质量低或异常表现则会导致二者出现分歧。 我们在六次确定性前向传播中，通过计算全局预测与五个固定空间裁剪区域均值之间的詹森-香农散度（JSD）来衡量这种分歧。 这种几何信号无需内部机制、采样或参考数据，并且与 TTA（Krizhevsky 等人，2012；Wang 等人，2019）存在根本区别（引理 1；第 5.4.1 节）。 将 MUS 与熵、置信度和 ℓ₁ \ell_{1} 进行有监督的逻辑回归融合可进一步提升故障检测能力，但在严重偏移的情况下，MC-Dropout 仍然更优。

paragraphs.en: Our key contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: SpatialUQ : A post-hoc uncertainty framework for frozen black-box classifiers using only output probabilities, with no internals, gradients, training data, or retraining. MUS is natively calibrated and extends to frozen foundation models, reaching 0.899 0.899 AUC with BiomedCLIP ( ρ = 0.846 \rho=0.846 ). Spatial perturbations provide the key signal, with photometric JSD reducing AUC from 0.784 0.784 to 0.755 0.755 .
paragraphs.zh: SpatialUQ：一种事后不确定性框架，专为冻结的黑箱分类器设计，仅需输出概率，无需内部信息、梯度、训练数据或重新训练。 MUS 具有原生校准能力，并可扩展至冻结的基础模型，在 BiomedCLIP 上实现了 0.899 的 AUC（ρ = 0.846）。 空间扰动提供了关键信号，而光度 JSD 则将 AUC 从 0.784 降低至 0.755。

sents.en: SpatialUQ : A post-hoc uncertainty framework for frozen black-box classifiers using only output probabilities, with no internals, gradients, training data, or retraining.

paragraphs.en: Formalization and self-diagnosing deployment gate : A formal bound connects MUS to mean absolute spatial probability shift, while a small labeled calibration sample provides a deployment diagnostic. The correlation remains meaningful in-distribution ( ρ = 0.523 \rho=0.523 ) but collapses under severe shift (VinBigData, ρ = 0.027 \rho=0.027 ).
paragraphs.zh: 形式化与自诊断部署门控：一个形式化的界限将最小超集（MUS）与平均绝对空间概率偏移联系起来，而一个小型的带标签校准样本则提供了部署诊断依据。 这种相关性在分布内仍然具有显著意义（ρ = 0.523 \rho=0.523），但在严重分布偏移下却会消失（VinBigData，ρ = 0.027 \rho=0.027）。

sents.en: Formalization and self-diagnosing deployment gate : A formal bound connects MUS to mean absolute spatial probability shift, while a small labeled calibration sample provides a deployment diagnostic.

paragraphs.en: State-of-the-art failure detection at one-fifth the cost : MUS achieves 0.784 0.784 AUC on NIH ChestX-ray14, outperforming MC-Dropout ( 0.664 0.664 , p < 10 − 6 p<10^{-6} ) with 6 vs. 30 forward passes. Fusion reaches 0.832 0.832 AUC, exceeding a five-member ensemble ( 0.813 0.813 ) without retraining.
paragraphs.zh: 以五分之一成本实现当前最先进的故障检测：MUS 在 NIH ChestX-ray14 数据集上取得了 0.784 0.784 的 AUC，优于 MC-Dropout（0.664 0.664，p < 10⁻⁶ p<10^{-6}），且仅需 6 次前向传播，而后者需要 30 次。 融合模型达到了 0.832 0.832 的 AUC，超越了由五个成员组成的集成模型（0.813 0.813），且无需重新训练。

sents.en: State-of-the-art failure detection at one-fifth the cost : MUS achieves 0.784 0.784 AUC on NIH ChestX-ray14, outperforming MC-Dropout ( 0.664 0.664 , p < 10 − 6 p<10^{-6} ) with 6 vs. 30 forward passes.

paragraphs.en: Cross-domain transferability : MUS achieves 0.708 0.708 AUC on CheXpert, a 0.109 0.109 gain over MC-Dropout; fusion reaches 0.917 0.917 – 0.937 0.937 on ImageNet and 0.885 0.885 – 0.913 0.913 on MS COCO.
paragraphs.zh: 跨域迁移能力：MUS在CheXpert上实现了0.708 0.708的AUC，比MC-Dropout提升了0.109 0.109；融合模型在ImageNet上的表现达到0.917 0.917 – 0.937 0.937，在MS COCO上则为0.885 0.885 – 0.913 0.913。

paragraphs.en: Spatial inconsistency is complementary rather than universal, it excels when models are overconfident on multi-label tasks but degrades when failures are spatially uniform.
paragraphs.zh: 空间不一致性具有互补性而非普适性：当模型在多标签任务中过度自信时，它能发挥出色效果；但当错误在空间上呈现均匀分布时，其表现则会下降。

paragraphs.en: MC-Dropout approximates Bayesian inference via T T stochastic forward passes but requires dropout layers to be present at training time, making it inapplicable to frozen checkpoints ( Gal and Ghahramani, 2016 ) . Bayesian weight approximations offer principled posteriors but scale poorly ( Graves, 2011 ; Blundell et al., 2015 ) . Deep Ensembles achieve strong calibration at the cost of multiplying compute ( Lakshminarayanan et al., 2017 ) . A recent benchmark of 13 such techniques on multi-label chest X-ray data confirms no single method is universally optimal ( Baur et al., 2025 ) . SpatialUQ imposes no training-time assumptions
paragraphs.zh: MC-Dropout 通过 T 次随机前向传播来近似贝叶斯推断，但要求训练时存在 dropout 层，因此无法应用于已冻结的检查点（Gal 和 Ghahramani，2016）。 贝叶斯权重近似方法提供了理论严谨的后验分布，但其可扩展性较差（Graves，2011；Blundell 等，2015）。 Deep Ensembles 实现了良好的校准效果，但代价是计算量的成倍增加（Lakshminarayanan 等，2017）。 最近一项针对多标签胸部 X 射线数据的 13 种此类技术的基准测试证实，没有任何一种方法是普遍最优的（Baur 等，2025）。 SpatialUQ 在训练阶段不施加任何假设。

sents.en: MC-Dropout approximates Bayesian inference via T T stochastic forward passes but requires dropout layers to be present at training time, making it inapplicable to frozen checkpoints ( Gal and Ghahramani, 2016 ) .
sents.zh: MC-Dropout 通过 T 次随机前向传播来近似贝叶斯推断，但要求训练时存在 dropout 层，因此无法应用于已冻结的检查点（Gal 和 Ghahramani，2016）。

sents.en: Bayesian weight approximations offer principled posteriors but scale poorly ( Graves, 2011 ; Blundell et al., 2015 ) .
sents.zh: 贝叶斯权重近似方法提供了理论严谨的后验分布，但其可扩展性较差（Graves，2011；Blundell 等，2015）。

sents.en: Deep Ensembles achieve strong calibration at the cost of multiplying compute ( Lakshminarayanan et al., 2017 ) .
sents.zh: Deep Ensembles 实现了良好的校准效果，但代价是计算量的成倍增加（Lakshminarayanan 等，2017）。

sents.en: A recent benchmark of 13 such techniques on multi-label chest X-ray data confirms no single method is universally optimal ( Baur et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 最近一项针对多标签胸部 X 射线数据的 13 种此类技术的基准测试证实，没有任何一种方法是普遍最优的（Baur 等，2025）。

sents.en: SpatialUQ imposes no training-time assumptions
sents.zh: SpatialUQ 在训练阶段不施加任何假设。

paragraphs.en: TTA treats prediction variance across augmentations as an uncertainty proxy ( Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ; Wang et al., 2019 ; Ayhan and Berens, 2018 ) , though strategy matters more than diversity ( Shanmugam et al., 2021 ) . Geometric and photometric augmentations confound spatial ambiguity with color/contrast sensitivity. SpatialUQ instead measures whether predictions are stable across spatial sub-regions a geometric property of evidence localization formalized in Lemma 1 and compared against photometric TTA-JSD in Section 5.4.1 .
paragraphs.zh: TTA将增强过程中预测的方差视为不确定性的代理指标（Krizhevsky等，2012；Wang等，2019；Ayhan和Berens，2018），尽管策略比多样性更为关键（Shanmugam等，2021）。 几何和光度增强会将空间模糊性与颜色/对比度敏感性混淆。 SpatialUQ则衡量预测在不同空间子区域中的稳定性——这是证据定位的一项几何属性，已在引理1中形式化，并在第5.4.1节中与光度TTA-JSD进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: Mahalanobis distance ( Lee et al., 2018 ) , DDU ( Mukhoti et al., 2021 ) , energy scoring, and ODIN ( Liu et al., 2020 ; Liang et al., 2017 ) operate on training-set feature distributions or logits. Conformal prediction provides distribution-free coverage guaranties but constructs prediction sets rather than ranking inputs by failure probability ( Angelopoulos and Bates, 2023 ) . SpatialUQ produces a scalar triage score. Combining MUS-based ranking with conformal calibration is a natural future direction.
paragraphs.zh: Mahalanobis 距离（Lee 等人，2018）、DDU（Mukhoti 等人，2021）、能量评分以及 ODIN（Liu 等人，2020；Liang 等人，2017）均基于训练集的特征分布或 logits 进行计算。 共形预测提供了与分布无关的覆盖保证，但它构建的是预测集，而非根据失败概率对输入进行排序（Angelopoulos 和 Bates，2023）。 SpatialUQ 会生成一个标量分类评分。 将基于 MUS 的排序与共形校准相结合，是一个自然的未来研究方向。

paragraphs.en: MC-Dropout has been applied to retinopathy screening ( Leibig et al., 2017 ) and brain segmentation ( Roy et al., 2019 ) . The aleatoric/epistemic distinction was formalized by Kendall and Gal (2017) and clinical motivation is surveyed by Begoli et al. (2019) . Temperature scaling addresses overconfidence ( Guo et al., 2017 ) and selective prediction provides the risk-coverage framework for triage ( Geifman and El-Yaniv, 2017 ) . We follow Nado et al. (2021) , reporting ECE, AURC, E-AURC, AUPR, and FPR at fixed TPR.
paragraphs.zh: MC-Dropout 已被应用于视网膜病变筛查（Leibig 等人，2017）和大脑分割（Roy 等人，2019）。 Kendall 和 Gal（2017）将偶然性/认知性区分进行了形式化，Begoli 等人（2019）则综述了其临床动机。 温度缩放可解决过度自信问题（Guo 等人，2017），而选择性预测则为分诊提供了风险覆盖框架（Geifman 和 El-Yaniv，2017）。我们遵循 Nado 等人 （2021）的做法，报告了在固定 TPR 下的 ECE、AURC、E-AURC、AUPR 和 FPR。

paragraphs.en: Failure detection without ground truth has been studied in object detection ( Miller et al., 2019 ) , with likelihood-ratio scores proposed as OOD detectors ( Ren et al., 2019 ) . Our MS COCO evaluation extends SpatialUQ to detection via a multi-label Bernoulli formulation. Prior calibration work on ViT ( Fort et al., 2019 ; Minderer et al., 2021 ) and globally coherent self-attention ( Liu et al., 2021 ) motivates our investigation of masking versus up-sampling for crop construction.
paragraphs.zh: 在没有真实标签的情况下进行故障检测的问题已在目标检测领域得到研究（Miller 等人，2019），其中有人提出使用似然比分数作为 OOD 检测器（Ren 等人，2019）。 我们的 MS COCO 评估通过将多标签伯努利公式应用于检测任务，将 SpatialUQ 扩展到了目标检测领域。 先前针对 ViT（Fort 等人，2019；Minderer 等人，2021）以及全局连贯自注意力机制（Liu 等人，2021）的校准研究，启发我们探索在构建裁剪区域时采用掩码处理与上采样方法之间的差异。

paragraphs.en: Predictive entropy ( Shannon, 1948 ) and mutual information ( Houlsby et al., 2011 ) are canonical output-space baselines. JSD’s symmetry, boundedness in [ 0 , log ⁡ 2 ] [0,\log 2] , and robustness to zero probability mass make it well-suited to multi-label sigmoid outputs ( Goodfellow et al., 2014 ; Hinton et al., 2015 ) . To our knowledge, SpatialUQ is the first to apply JSD between global and local spatial predictions as a failure detection proxy, introducing a geometrically grounded interpretation requiring no model internals.
paragraphs.zh: 预测熵（Shannon，1948）和互信息（Houlsby 等，2011）是输出空间的标准基线。 JSD 的对称性、在 [0, log₂] 范围内的有界性以及对零概率质量的鲁棒性，使其非常适合多标签 Sigmoid 输出（Goodfellow 等，2014；Hinton 等，2015）。 据我们所知，SpatialUQ 是首次将全局与局部空间预测之间的 JSD 用作故障检测代理，提出了一种基于几何原理的解释方法，且无需依赖模型内部信息。

sents.en: Predictive entropy ( Shannon, 1948 ) and mutual information ( Houlsby et al., 2011 ) are canonical output-space baselines.
sents.zh: 预测熵（Shannon，1948）和互信息（Houlsby 等，2011）是输出空间的标准基线。

sents.en: JSD’s symmetry, boundedness in [ 0 , log ⁡ 2 ] [0,\log 2] , and robustness to zero probability mass make it well-suited to multi-label sigmoid outputs ( Goodfellow et al., 2014 ; Hinton et al., 2015 ) .

sents.en: To our knowledge, SpatialUQ is the first to apply JSD between global and local spatial predictions as a failure detection proxy, introducing a geometrically grounded interpretation requiring no model internals.
sents.zh: 据我们所知，SpatialUQ 是首次将全局与局部空间预测之间的 JSD 用作故障检测代理，提出了一种基于几何原理的解释方法，且无需依赖模型内部信息。

paragraphs.en: SpatialUQ operationalizes the spatial consistency hypothesis through a deterministic five-crop decomposition. We formalize the score for single- and multi-label settings, describe the optional linear fusion, and bound the score against per-class probability shifts. Figure 1 illustrates the pipeline and qualitative examples.
paragraphs.zh: SpatialUQ 通过一种确定性的五裁剪分解方法，将空间一致性假设具体化为可操作的形式。 我们为单标签和多标签场景正式定义了评分机制，描述了可选的线性融合方法，并建立了该评分与各类别概率偏移之间的界限关系。 图 1 展示了整个流程以及定性示例。

sents.en: SpatialUQ operationalizes the spatial consistency hypothesis through a deterministic five-crop decomposition.
sents.zh: SpatialUQ 通过一种确定性的五裁剪分解方法，将空间一致性假设具体化为可操作的形式。

sents.en: We formalize the score for single- and multi-label settings, describe the optional linear fusion, and bound the score against per-class probability shifts.
sents.zh: 我们为单标签和多标签场景正式定义了评分机制，描述了可选的线性融合方法，并建立了该评分与各类别概率偏移之间的界限关系。

paragraphs.en: Lemma 1 shows a large SpatialUQ score necessarily implies a large mean absolute shift between global and local class probabilities. This concerns probability shift only; that MUS predicts failures is empirical: the Spearman correlation between s bern s_{\text{bern}} and per-image Brier score is positive and highly significant ( p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ) across all medical benchmarks, which licenses MUS as a failure signal. The bound is conservative under heterogeneous per-class JSD via Jensen’s inequality.
paragraphs.zh: 引理 1 表明，较大的 SpatialUQ 分数必然意味着全局和局部类别概率之间存在较大的均值绝对偏移。 这仅涉及概率偏移；MUS 能够预测失败这一点是经验性的：在所有医学基准测试中，s bern s_{\text{bern}} 与每张图像的 Brier 分数之间的 Spearman 相关系数为正且高度显著（p < 0.0001 p<0.0001），因此可以将 MUS 用作失败信号。 通过 Jensen 不等式可知，在每类 JSD 异质的情况下，该界限是保守的。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SpatialUQ across twelve configurations spanning medical and natural image classification and object detection. NIH ChestX-ray14 ( Wang et al., 2017 ) (112,120 frontal chest X-rays, 14 multi-label diseases; patient-wise split 73,891/12,633/25,596 train/val/test; class-balanced BCE for 5.3 × 5.3\times – 641.5 × 641.5\times imbalance) trains three architectures independently: DenseNet-121 ( Huang et al., 2017 ) , EfficientNet-B4 ( Tan and Le, 2019 ) , and ViT-B/16 ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2020 ) . CLIP ViT-B/32 and BiomedCLIP are evaluated on the same NIH test set via linear-probe transfer (frozen backbones). CheXpert ( Irvin et al., 2019 ) and VinBigData ( Nguyen et al., 2022 ) serve as zero-shot transfer benchmarks for the NIH-trained DenseNet-121 (10 NIH-shared classes each; Appendix L ; U-Zeros for uncertain CheXpert labels). ImageNet-1k evaluates three pretrained models (EfficientNet-B4, ViT-B/16, ConvNeXt-Tiny ( Liu et al., 2022 ) ) zero-shot on 50,000 validation images with categorical JSD; failure is top-1 misclassification. MS COCO 2014 ( Lin et al., 2014 ) evaluates Faster R-CNN ( Ren et al., 2015 ) and RetinaNet ( Lin et al., 2017 ) (ResNet-50-FPN) on a 5,000-image subset (seed 42), with per-class confidence as the maximum detection score (threshold 0.1; 0.05/0.30 confirm stability) and Bernoulli JSD over 80-dimensional vectors.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在涵盖医学和自然图像分类及目标检测的十二种配置中评估了 SpatialUQ。 NIH ChestX-ray14（Wang 等人，2017）（包含 112,120 张正面胸部 X 光片，14 种多标签疾病；按患者划分的训练/验证/测试集为 73,891/12,633/25,596；针对 5.3 × 5.3\times – 641.5 × 641.5\times 的类别不平衡问题，采用类别平衡 BCE）独立训练了三种架构：DenseNet-121（Huang 等人，2017）、EfficientNet-B4（Tan 和 Le，2019）以及 ViT-B/16（Dosovitskiy 等人，2020）。 CLIP ViT-B/32 和 BiomedCLIP 通过线性探针迁移（冻结骨干网络）在相同的 NIH 测试集上进行评估。 CheXpert（Irvin 等人，2019）和 VinBigData（Nguyen 等人，2022）用作 NIH 训练的 DenseNet-121 的零样本迁移基准（两者均包含 10 个与 NIH 共享的类别；见附录 L；对不确定的 CheXpert 标签使用 U-Zeros）。 ImageNet-1k 对三种预训练模型（EfficientNet-B4、ViT-B/16、ConvNeXt-Tiny（Liu 等人，2022））在 50,000 张验证图像上进行零样本评估，采用分类 JSD；失败定义为 top-1 错误分类。 MS COCO 2014（Lin 等人，2014）在包含 5,000 张图像的子集（种子为 42）上评估了 Faster R-CNN（Ren 等人，2015）和 RetinaNet（Lin 等人，2017）（ResNet-50-FPN），其中每个类别的置信度作为最大检测分数（阈值 0.1；0.05/0.30 用于确认稳定性），并基于 80 维向量计算伯努利 JSD。

sents.en: We evaluate SpatialUQ across twelve configurations spanning medical and natural image classification and object detection.
sents.zh: 我们在涵盖医学和自然图像分类及目标检测的十二种配置中评估了 SpatialUQ。

paragraphs.en: A prediction is labeled a failure if its per-image Brier score exceeds the 75th percentile of the test-set Brier distribution, yielding a consistent 25% failure rate across all datasets and architectures for direct cross-domain comparison without dataset-specific tuning (robustness to the 50th, 75th, and 90th percentile thresholds is confirmed in Appendix E.3 . Critically, the Brier score is computed against ground-truth labels and is epistemically independent of MUS, which operates solely on output probabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 如果预测的每张图片的布里尔分数超过了测试集布里尔分布的第75百分位数，则该预测被标记为失败；由此在所有数据集和架构中均保持稳定的25%失败率，从而实现无需针对特定数据集进行调整的直接跨域比较（对第50、75和90百分位数阈值的鲁棒性已在附录E.3中得到证实）。 关键在于，布里尔分数是基于真实标签计算的，并且在认识论上独立于MUS，因为MUS仅基于输出概率进行运作。

paragraphs.en: NIH architectures are fine-tuned from ImageNet-pretrained weights in two stages: (i) 5 epochs with frozen backbone (lr 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , AdamW, weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} ); (ii) up to 25 epochs (patience 7) unfrozen (backbone lr 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} , head lr 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} , cosine annealing to 10 − 7 10^{-7} ). Loss is BCE with label smoothing ( ε = 0.1 \varepsilon=0.1 ) and class-balanced pos_weight , augmentation is random rotation ( ± 10 ∘ \pm 10^{\circ} ) and crop to 224 × 224 224\times 224 (no horizontal flip, preserving laterality), batch size 32. ImageNet and COCO models are evaluated zero-shot full details in Appendix J .
paragraphs.zh: NIH 架构通过两个阶段从在 ImageNet 上预训练的权重中进行微调：(i) 冻结主干网络，进行 5 个周期（学习率 3 × 10⁻⁴，AdamW，权重衰减 10⁻⁴）；(ii) 解冻网络，最多进行 25 个周期（耐心值 7），其中主干网络学习率为 5 × 10⁻⁶，头部网络学习率为 5 × 10⁻⁵，并使用余弦退火将学习率降至 10⁻⁷。 损失函数为带标签平滑（ε = 0.1）和类别平衡 pos_weight 的 BCE；数据增强包括随机旋转（±10°）和裁剪至 224 × 224（无水平翻转，保持左右对称性），批量大小为 32。 ImageNet 和 COCO 模型的零样本完整评估细节见附录 J。

paragraphs.en: We compare against 17 uncertainty methods from the same frozen model without retraining. Output-space : predictive entropy ( Shannon, 1948 ) , inverted confidence (raw and temperature-scaled), ℓ 1 \ell_{1} distance, and maximum inter-crop disagreement. Crop-based : patch variance, pairwise disagreement, and pairwise JSD. For reproducibility: patch variance is the variance of per-class probabilities across the five crops, averaged over classes, pairwise disagreement is the mean absolute difference between all pairs of crop predictions, pairwise JSD is the mean JSD between all pairs of crop predictions. Augmentation-based : TTA variance, TTA-JSD (10 augmentations), and MC-Dropout ( Gal and Ghahramani, 2016 ) (30 passes). Feature/logit-based : DDU ( Mukhoti et al., 2021 ) , Mahalanobis distance ( Lee et al., 2018 ) , and ODIN ( Liang et al., 2017 ) . Ensemble : mean prediction entropy, ensemble variance, and temperature-scaled entropy ( Lakshminarayanan et al., 2017 ) from five DenseNet-121 models. Hyperparameters follow respective publications (Appendix J ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们与来自同一冻结模型、未经重新训练的 17 种不确定性方法进行了比较。 输出空间：预测熵（Shannon, 1948）、反向置信度（原始和温度缩放版）、ℓ₁ \ell_{1} 距离以及最大跨裁剪块分歧度。 基于裁剪块的方法：补丁方差、成对分歧度以及成对 JSD。 为确保可重复性：补丁方差是五个裁剪块中各类别概率的方差，并对类别取平均；成对分歧度是所有裁剪块预测值之间绝对差值的平均值；成对 JSD 是所有裁剪块预测值之间 JSD 的平均值。 基于数据增强方法：TTA 方差、TTA-JSD（10 次增强）以及 MC-Dropout（Gal and Ghahramani, 2016）（30 次遍历）。 基于特征/逻辑单元的方法：DDU（Mukhoti et al., 2021）、马氏距离（Lee et al., 2018）以及 ODIN（Liang et al., 2017）。 集成方法：来自五个 DenseNet-121 模型的平均预测熵、集成方差以及温度缩放熵（Lakshminarayanan et al., 2017）。 超参数遵循各自论文中的设定（附录 J）。

sents.zh: 基于裁剪块的方法：补丁方差、成对分歧度以及成对 JSD。

sents.en: For reproducibility: patch variance is the variance of per-class probabilities across the five crops, averaged over classes, pairwise disagreement is the mean absolute difference between all pairs of crop predictions, pairwise JSD is the mean JSD between all pairs of crop predictions.
sents.zh: 为确保可重复性：补丁方差是五个裁剪块中各类别概率的方差，并对类别取平均；成对分歧度是所有裁剪块预测值之间绝对差值的平均值；成对 JSD 是所有裁剪块预测值之间 JSD 的平均值。

sents.en: Augmentation-based : TTA variance, TTA-JSD (10 augmentations), and MC-Dropout ( Gal and Ghahramani, 2016 ) (30 passes).
sents.zh: 基于数据增强方法：TTA 方差、TTA-JSD（10 次增强）以及 MC-Dropout（Gal and Ghahramani, 2016）（30 次遍历）。

sents.en: Feature/logit-based : DDU ( Mukhoti et al., 2021 ) , Mahalanobis distance ( Lee et al., 2018 ) , and ODIN ( Liang et al., 2017 ) .
sents.zh: 基于特征/逻辑单元的方法：DDU（Mukhoti et al., 2021）、马氏距离（Lee et al., 2018）以及 ODIN（Liang et al., 2017）。

sents.en: Ensemble : mean prediction entropy, ensemble variance, and temperature-scaled entropy ( Lakshminarayanan et al., 2017 ) from five DenseNet-121 models.
sents.zh: 集成方法：来自五个 DenseNet-121 模型的平均预测熵、集成方差以及温度缩放熵（Lakshminarayanan et al., 2017）。

sents.en: Hyperparameters follow respective publications (Appendix J ).
sents.zh: 超参数遵循各自论文中的设定（附录 J）。

paragraphs.en: The primary metric is AUC for binary failure detection, we additionally report AUPR, AURC, E-AURC, and FPR at 80% and 95% TPR. We adopt the AURC formulation of Nado et al. (2021) over AUGRC ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , as the fixed 25% failure rate renders the two equivalent. Calibration uses Score Calibration Error (SCE; ECE with 15 bins on min-max normalized scores). All metrics include 95% bootstrap CIs (1,000 resamples), pairwise AUC significance uses DeLong tests and two-tailed bootstrap p p -values (10,000 resamples). All experiments use seed 42, code and data splits are included in the supplementary material and will be released publicly upon acceptance.
paragraphs.zh: 主要指标是用于二元故障检测的 AUC，此外我们还报告了 AUPR、AURC、E-AURC 以及在 80% 和 95% TPR 下的 FPR。我们采用 Nado 等人（2021）提出的 AURC 公式，而非 AUGRC（Zhou 等人，2024），因为固定的 25% 故障率使两者等效。校准部分使用评分校准误差（SCE；即对最小-最大归一化评分进行 15 个分箱的 ECE）。所有指标均包含 95% 的自助置信区间（1,000 次重采样），成对 AUC 显著性检验采用 DeLong 检验和双尾自助 p 值（10,000 次重采样）。所有实验均使用种子 42，代码和数据划分已包含在补充材料中，并在论文被接受后公开发布。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 reports failure detection on NIH ChestX-ray14 ( N = 25,596 N{=}25{,}596 ) using DenseNet-121. MUS reaches an AUC of 0.784 0.784 (95% CI [ 0.778 , 0.789 ] [0.778,0.789] ) with six deterministic forward passes, outperforming MC-Dropout ( 0.664 0.664 , Δ = + 0.119 \Delta{=}{+}0.119 , p < 10 − 6 p{<}10^{-6} ; 30 stochastic passes) while reducing wall-clock time by 5 × 5\times ( ≈ \approx 8 vs. ≈ \approx 39 min, Appendix J ). Although ℓ 1 \ell_{1} achieves a slightly higher AUC ( 0.790 0.790 vs. 0.784 0.784 , Δ = 0.006 \Delta{=}0.006 , p < 10 − 6 p{<}10^{-6} ), its calibration is substantially worse (SCE 0.127 0.127 vs. 0.049 0.049 ). Naive crop variance performs much worse ( 0.610 0.610 AUC), showing that the way crop predictions are aggregated is important. Confidence and entropy are close to chance ( 0.401 0.401 and 0.177 0.177 ), reflecting systematic BCE overconfidence from label smoothing and class-balanced loss; temperature scaling does not recover the signal ( 0.400 0.400 ).
paragraphs.zh: 表1报告了使用DenseNet-121在NIH ChestX-ray14数据集（N = 25,596 N{=}25{,}596）上的故障检测结果。 MUS通过六次确定性前向传播达到了0.784 0.784的AUC值（95% CI [ 0.778 , 0.789 ] [0.778,0.789]），优于MC-Dropout（0.664 0.664，Δ = + 0.119 \Delta{=}{+}0.119，p < 10 − 6 p{<}10^{-6}；30次随机传播），同时将实际运行时间减少了5倍（5 × 5\times，即约 \approx 8分钟对比约 \approx 39分钟，见附录J）。 尽管ℓ 1 \ell_{1}实现了略高的AUC值（0.790 0.790对比0.784 0.784，Δ = 0.006 \Delta{=}0.006，p < 10 − 6 p{<}10^{-6}），但其校准效果明显更差（SCE为0.127 0.127对比0.049 0.049）。 简单的裁剪方差方法表现更差（AUC为0.610 0.610），这表明裁剪预测的聚合方式至关重要。 置信度和熵值接近随机水平（分别为0.401 0.401和0.177 0.177），反映出标签平滑和类别平衡损失导致的系统性BCE过自信问题；温度缩放未能恢复有效信号（0.400 0.400）。

paragraphs.en: This advantage is specific to the overconfidence regime encountered here. On well-calibrated ImageNet classifiers, confidence alone reaches 0.913 0.913 – 0.923 0.923 AUC, compared with 0.641 0.641 – 0.717 0.717 for MUS, although MUS still provides complementary information in fusion (Section 5.6 ). Combining MUS, entropy, confidence, and ℓ 1 \ell_{1} through 5-fold cross-validation on the validation set increases AUC to 0.832 0.832 , outperforming a five-member deep ensemble ( 0.813 0.813 , Δ = + 0.019 \Delta{=}{+}0.019 , p < 10 − 6 p{<}10^{-6} ) at a fraction of the training cost. MUS also tracks model error monotonically ( ρ = 0.523 \rho{=}0.523 , p < 10 − 6 p{<}10^{-6} ), and the same behavior extends to EfficientNet-B4 and ViT-B/16 (Appendix C ). Finally, spatial disagreement heatmaps show that high-MUS failures concentrate crop-level JSD in ambiguous regions (Appendix K ).
paragraphs.zh: 这种优势仅适用于此处所遇到的过度自信机制。 在良好校准的 ImageNet 分类器上，仅凭置信度即可达到 0.913–0.923 的 AUC，而 MUS 的 AUC 为 0.641–0.717；尽管如此，MUS 在融合过程中仍能提供补充信息（第 5.6 节）。 通过在验证集上进行 5 折交叉验证，将 MUS、熵、置信度和 ℓ₁ 结合使用，可将 AUC 提升至 0.832，优于一个由五个模型组成的深度集成模型（0.813，Δ = +0.019，p < 10⁻⁶），且训练成本仅为后者的一小部分。 MUS 还能单调追踪模型误差（ρ = 0.523，p < 10⁻⁶），且这一特性同样适用于 EfficientNet-B4 和 ViT-B/16（附录 C）。 最后，空间分歧热图显示，MUS 值高的失败案例主要集中在具有歧义的区域的作物级 JSD 上（附录 K）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 shows that MUS achieves 0.784 0.784 AUC with six deterministic passes, outperforming MC-Dropout ( 0.664 0.664 ), crop-variance TTA ( 0.610 0.610 ), and all other TTA variants ( ≤ 0.584 \leq 0.584 ) without ensembles, stochastic inference, or auxiliary supervision. Fusion further improves performance to 0.832 0.832 AUC by combining MUS with complementary signals.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 显示，MUS 在六次确定性通过后实现了 0.784 0.784 的 AUC，优于 MC-Dropout（0.664 0.664）、crop-variance TTA（0.610 0.610）以及所有其他无需集成、随机推理或辅助监督的 TTA 变体（≤ 0.584 \leq 0.584）。 通过将 MUS 与互补信号相结合，融合方法进一步将性能提升至 0.832 0.832 AUC。

paragraphs.en: We apply the NIH protocol to frozen CLIP ViT-B/32 ( Radford et al., 2021 ) and BiomedCLIP ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) via linear-probe transfer. Confidence -1 collapses on uncalibrated medical outputs ( 0.095 0.095 / 0.206 0.206 AUC), while MUS remains strong at 0.825 0.825 ( ρ = 0.631 \rho{=}0.631 ) and 0.899 0.899 ( ρ = 0.846 \rho{=}0.846 , p < 10 − 6 p{<}10^{-6} ), respectively. Although ℓ 1 \ell_{1} has slightly higher AUC, MUS is better calibrated (SCE 0.133 0.133 vs. 0.232 0.232 ), and fusion reaches 0.883 0.883 / 0.925 0.925 . SpatialUQ therefore transfers across general and domain-specific foundation models without architectural access (Appendix C.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过线性探针迁移，将 NIH 协议应用于冷冻 CLIP ViT-B/32（Radford 等人，2021）和 BiomedCLIP（Zhang 等人，2023）。 对于未经校准的医学输出，置信度 -1 的性能会大幅下降（AUC 为 0.095 / 0.206），而 MUS 的表现依然强劲，分别达到 0.825（ρ = 0.631）和 0.899（ρ = 0.846，p < 10⁻⁶）。 尽管 ℓ₁ 的 AUC 略高，但 MUS 的校准效果更好（SCE 为 0.133 对比 0.232），且融合后的性能达到 0.883 / 0.925。 因此，SpatialUQ 无需访问模型架构即可在通用和领域特定的基础模型之间实现迁移（附录 C.2）。

paragraphs.en: Calibration determines whether a threshold is clinically meaningful, AUC measures only ranking. Figure 3 shows MUS natively calibrated ( SCE = 0.049 \text{SCE}{=}0.049 ) versus raw ℓ 1 \ell_{1} ( 0.127 0.127 ). A labeled hold-out lets isotonic regression calibrate ℓ 1 \ell_{1} ( 0.006 0.006 / 0.789 0.789 ) and fusion ( 0.004 0.004 / 0.830 0.830 ), but such labels are unavailable for frozen black-box deployment, where MUS remains the only natively calibrated discriminative option for deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 校准决定了阈值是否具有临床意义，而 AUC 仅衡量排序能力。 图 3 展示了 MUS 的原生校准结果（SCE = 0.049 \text{SCE}{=}0.049）与原始 ℓ₁（0.127 0.127）的对比。 带标签的预留数据集允许等单调回归对 ℓ₁（0.006 0.006 / 0.789 0.789）和融合模型（0.004 0.004 / 0.830 0.830）进行校准，但在冻结的黑箱部署场景下，这类标签并不可用，此时 MUS 仍然是部署中唯一原生校准的判别性选项。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 shows entropy is the most critical fusion component (removal: − 0.044 -0.044 AUC). MUS and ℓ 1 \ell_{1} add complementary gains ( − 0.005 -0.005 , − 0.007 -0.007 ), confidence negligibly ( − 0.001 -0.001 ). Yet entropy alone reaches only 0.177 0.177 AUC under BCE overconfidence while MUS reaches 0.784 0.784 alone, so fusion gains come from orthogonal failure modes. Five fixed crops are optimal (Appendix E ), nine crops gain only + 0.007 +0.007 AUC at 67 % 67\% additional cost, three crops lose 0.007 0.007 , and 1,000 1{,}000 random placements reach 0.739 0.739 (Appendix E.1 ). These results confirm the fixed geometric arrangement provides superior spatial coverage (Appendix E.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 表2显示，熵是最关键的融合组件（移除后：−0.044 -0.044 AUC）。 MUS和ℓ₁ \ell_{1}带来了互补的提升（−0.005 -0.005、−0.007 -0.007），而置信度的提升可忽略不计（−0.001 -0.001）。 然而，在BCE过度自信的情况下，仅使用熵只能达到0.177 0.177 AUC，而单独使用MUS则能达到0.784 0.784，因此融合带来的提升源于正交的失效模式。 五种固定裁剪是最优的（附录E），九种裁剪仅在增加67% 67\%成本的情况下带来了+0.007 +0.007 AUC的提升，三种裁剪则损失了0.007 0.007，而1,000 1{,}000个随机放置的位置仅能达到0.739 0.739（附录E.1）。 这些结果证实了固定的几何排列能够提供更优的空间覆盖（附录E.2）。

paragraphs.en: The identical Bernoulli JSD on five photometric augmentations (brightness ± 0.15 \pm 0.15 , contrast × 1.2 \times 1.2 / × 0.8 \times 0.8 , noise σ = 0.05 \sigma{=}0.05 ) yields 0.755 0.755 AUC ( ρ = 0.493 \rho{=}0.493 ) versus MUS’s 0.784 0.784 ( ρ = 0.523 \rho{=}0.523 ) at the same six passes, with marginally better calibration (SCE 0.043 0.043 vs. 0.049 0.049 ). The AUC advantage confirms the gain comes from the perturbation’s geometric structure, not the divergence measure.

On CheXpert, MUS achieves 0.708 0.708 AUC versus 0.599 0.599 for MC-Dropout ( Δ = + 0.109 \Delta{=}+0.109 , p < 10 − 6 p{<}10^{-6} ), with ρ \rho declining from 0.523 0.523 to 0.298 0.298 but retaining useful discrimination. At 20% referral, selective prediction improves system AUC from 0.686 0.686 to 0.748 0.748 + 19.7 +19.7 % relative gap reduction. Under severe shift on VinBigData, however, MC-Dropout outperforms MUS ( 0.764 0.764 vs. 0.614 0.614 , Δ = − 0.150 \Delta{=}-0.150 , p < 10 − 6 p{<}10^{-6} ), while ρ \rho collapses to 0.027 0.027 as failures become spatially uniform and MUS loses its inconsistency signal.

paragraphs.en: Table 4 evaluates ImageNet-1k (three architectures, 50,000 images) and MS COCO 2014 (two detectors, 5,000 images). On well-calibrated single-label classifiers, confidence already provides a strong correctness signal, making MUS complementary rather than a replacement (Section 6 ). On ImageNet, MUS alone trails Confidence -1 ( 0.641 0.641 – 0.717 0.717 vs. 0.913 0.913 – 0.923 0.923 AUC), but fusion reaches 0.917 0.917 – 0.937 0.937 , with MUS consistently contributing in leave-one-out ablations (Appendix G ). This suggests that spatial consistency provides information beyond confidence even when confidence is already highly predictive. On COCO, MUS is stronger as a standalone signal ( 0.800 0.800 / 0.747 0.747 AUC; ρ = 0.613 \rho{=}0.613 / 0.510 0.510 ), approaching the NIH in-distribution correlation and benefiting from the richer spatial structure of multi-label detection. Entropy remains the strongest standalone signal ( 0.884 0.884 / 0.912 0.912 ), while fusion reaches 0.885 0.885 / 0.913 0.913 .
paragraphs.zh: 表4评估了ImageNet-1k（三种架构，50,000张图像）和MS COCO 2014（两种检测器，5,000张图像）。 对于校准良好的单标签分类器，置信度本身已能提供较强的正确性信号，因此MUS与其是互补关系，而非替代关系（第6节）。 在ImageNet上，单独使用MUS的AUC为0.641–0.717，低于置信度的0.913–0.923；但融合后的AUC达到0.917–0.937，且MUS在留一法消融实验中始终有贡献（附录G）。 这表明，即使置信度本身已具有高度预测能力，空间一致性仍能提供超越置信度的额外信息。 在COCO上，MUS作为独立信号更强（AUC为0.800/0.747；ρ=0.613/0.510），接近NIH的分布内相关性，并受益于多标签检测中更丰富的空间结构。 熵仍然是最强的独立信号（0.884/0.912），而融合后的结果达到0.885/0.913。

paragraphs.en: We simulate triage on the NIH test set (DenseNet-121). Referring the 9.2% highest-MUS images to human review recovers 20% of all Brier-defined failures at 54.5% referral precision. The threshold is tunable: precision is 58.7% at 10% recall (4.3% referred), 54.5% at 20%, 51.4% at 30% (Appendix I ). Rejecting the 20% most uncertain images raises mean test AUC 0.808 → 0.814 0.808{\to}0.814 ( Δ = + 0.006 \Delta{=}{+}0.006 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 NIH 测试集（DenseNet-121）上模拟了分诊流程。 将 MUS 值最高的 9.2% 图像转交人类审核，可在 54.5% 的转诊精确度下，纠正所有 Brier 定义失败中的 20%。 该阈值可调：在 10% 的召回率（4.3% 被转诊）时，精确度为 58.7%；在 20% 时为 54.5%；在 30% 时为 51.4%（附录 I）。 拒绝最不确定的 20% 图像后，测试集平均 AUC 从 0.808 提升至 0.814（Δ = +0.006）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 compares rejection quality across all methods against a random baseline. MUS monotonically lowers retained Brier ( 0.521 → 0.507 0.521{\to}0.507 at 30%) and beats MC-Dropout throughout. Fusion (CV) leads ( 0.504 0.504 ), with ℓ 1 \ell_{1} and ensemble ( 0.506 0.506 ) marginally ahead of MUS. MUS remains the best-calibrated unsupervised score above 0.78 AUC (SCE 0.049 0.049 vs. ℓ 1 \ell_{1} ’s 0.127 0.127 ). Entropy and confidence degrade the retained set, as expected from their near-chance AUC, since Brier defines the failure label, this restates the AUC ranking.
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 比较了所有方法在拒绝质量方面的表现，并与随机基线进行了对比。 MUS 单调降低了保留的布里尔得分（0.521 → 0.507，在 30% 时），并且在整个过程中优于 MC-Dropout。 融合（CV）表现最佳（0.504），其中 ℓ₁ 和集成方法（0.506）略高于 MUS。 在 AUC 高于 0.78 的情况下，MUS 仍然是校准效果最好的无监督得分（SCE 为 0.049，而 ℓ₁ 的 SCE 为 0.127）。 熵和置信度会劣化保留集合，这与其接近随机水平的 AUC 一致；由于布里尔得分定义了失败标签，因此这再次说明了 AUC 的排名关系。

paragraphs.en: MUS discrimination varies strongly across pathologies: it performs best on diffuse, globally visible conditions such as Pneumonia (JSD AUC 0.979 0.979 ) and Edema ( 0.971 0.971 ), but poorly on small focal lesions such as Nodule ( 0.368 0.368 ), Fibrosis ( 0.553 0.553 ), and Mass ( 0.558 0.558 ), reflecting a limitation of the five-crop design. However a 16-crop extension raises Nodule AUC to 0.589 0.589 Appendix H ). Prevalence-weighting across the 14 classes yields an overall AUC of 0.83 0.83 , but masks this weakness because the three hardest classes account for only 14% of positive findings. A focal-lesion-enriched benchmark would provide a more stringent test of MUS.
paragraphs.zh: MUS 的区分能力在不同病理类型间差异显著：它在弥漫性且全局可见的疾病（如肺炎，JSD AUC 0.979 0.979；水肿，0.971 0.971）中表现最佳，但在小范围局灶性病变（如结节，0.368 0.368；纤维化，0.553 0.553；肿块，0.558 0.558）中表现不佳，这反映了五裁剪设计的局限性。 然而，通过扩展至 16 裁剪，结节的 AUC 可提升至 0.589（附录 H）。 对 14 个类别进行患病率加权后，整体 AUC 为 0.83，但这掩盖了上述弱点，因为三个最难识别的类别仅占阳性结果的 14%。 一个富集局灶性病变的基准数据集将能更严格地检验 MUS 的能力。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows the top-to-bottom decile Brier ratio (95% CIs): 1.08 1.08 – 1.13 1.13 for diffuse classes but 0.95 0.95 [0.948, 0.960] for Nodule, indicating that high nodule disagreement concentrates on better-predicted images. Mass ( 1.01 1.01 ) and Fibrosis ( 0.99 0.99 ) show no meaningful coupling. Thus, disagreement does not track error for focal lesions, although this does not imply per-crop correctness. The limitation concerns the score rather than classifier quality: raw Nodule AUC ( 0.740 0.740 ) is near the 14-class mean ( 0.7885 0.7885 , Appendix B ). Full curves, referral statistics, and fairness analyzes are in Appendix I where gender parity is near-perfect ( 0.784 0.784 vs. 0.784 0.784 ).
paragraphs.zh: 图5展示了从上到下的十分位布里尔比率（95%置信区间）：弥漫性病变类别为1.08–1.13，而结节类病变则为0.95 [0.948, 0.960]，这表明高度不一致的结节预测主要集中在预测更准确的图像上。 肿块（1.01）和纤维化（0.99）未表现出有意义的耦合关系。 因此，对于局灶性病变而言，预测不一致性并不反映实际错误，但这并不意味着每个裁剪区域的预测都是正确的。 这一局限性涉及评分本身而非分类器的质量：结节的原始AUC为0.740，接近14个类别的平均值0.7885（附录B）。 完整曲线、转诊统计数据和公平性分析见附录I，其中性别平衡近乎完美（0.784 vs. 0.784）。

paragraphs.en: A practitioner summary of when to use MUS is provided in Appendix I.1 (Table 32 ).
paragraphs.zh: 关于何时使用 MUS 的从业者摘要见附录 I.1（表 32）。

paragraphs.en: MUS is most useful in overconfident multi-label settings where confidence is weak (NIH DenseNet-121: AUC 0.401 0.401 ). On well-calibrated single-label tasks such as ImageNet, confidence dominates and MUS is complementary, with fusion combining the two signals.
paragraphs.zh: MUS 在过度自信的多元标签设置中最为有效，此时置信度较弱（NIH DenseNet-121：AUC 0.401 0.401）。 在像 ImageNet 这样校准良好的单标签任务中，置信度起主导作用，而 MUS 则起到补充作用，融合过程将这两种信号结合起来。

paragraphs.en: MUS measures whether model confidence is spatially reproducible, which we view as an epistemic signal reflecting learned spatial grounding rather than irreducible label noise. Its correlation with model quality also provides a pre-deployment diagnostic: ρ ≲ 0.15 \rho\lesssim 0.15 flags severe shift, as observed on VinBigData ( ρ = 0.027 \rho=0.027 ), before full test-set evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: MUS 衡量模型置信度在空间上是否具有可重复性，我们认为这是一种认识论信号，反映了模型所学到的空间基础，而非不可简化的标签噪声。 它与模型质量的相关性也提供了一种部署前的诊断方法：ρ ≲ 0.15 \rho\lesssim 0.15 表示存在严重偏移，正如在 VinBigData 上观察到的那样（ρ = 0.027 \rho=0.027），这发生在完整的测试集评估之前。

paragraphs.en: Although ℓ 1 \ell_{1} slightly exceeds MUS in AUC ( 0.790 0.790 vs. 0.784 0.784 , Δ = 0.006 \Delta=0.006 ; p < 10 − 6 p<10^{-6} ), its SCE is substantially worse ( 0.127 0.127 vs. 0.049 0.049 ). Under shift, MUS also performs better on VinBigData ( 0.614 0.614 vs. 0.583 0.583 ), consistent with the robustness of bounded, symmetric JSD. Lemma 1 establishes the connection between MUS and ℓ 1 \ell_{1} , but the empirical advantage of MUS lies in its native calibration and shift robustness. Isotonic regression can calibrate ℓ 1 \ell_{1} (SCE 0.006 0.006 ), but requires labeled hold-out data unavailable in frozen deployment. Fusion’s higher SCE ( 0.246 0.246 ) is instead driven by the uncalibrated entropy component.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 ℓ₁ 在 AUC 上略优于 MUS（0.790 vs. 0.784，Δ = 0.006；p < 10⁻⁶），但其 SCE 却明显更差（0.127 vs. 0.049）。 在分布偏移情况下，MUS 在 VinBigData 上的表现也更好（0.614 vs. 0.583），这与有界对称 JSD 的鲁棒性一致。 引理 1 确立了 MUS 与 ℓ₁ 之间的联系，但 MUS 的经验优势在于其固有的校准能力和对分布偏移的鲁棒性。 等单调回归可以校准 ℓ₁（SCE 为 0.006），但这需要带标签的预留数据，而这些数据在冻结部署中并不可用。 Fusion 较高的 SCE（0.246）实际上是由未经校准的熵分量所导致的。

paragraphs.en: SpatialUQ has five main limitations. (i) Severe domain shift can collapse the inconsistency signal (VinBigData, ρ = 0.027 \rho=0.027 ). (ii) Five fixed crops limit sensitivity to small focal lesions (Nodule JSD AUC 0.368 0.368 ; 16-crop extension: 0.589 0.589 ). (iii) ViT global attention compresses MUS’s dynamic range, with masking recovering + 0.004 +0.004 AUC (Appendix C.4 ). (iv) Fusion requires a labeled hold-out set. (v) Generative VLMs with global pooling can weaken the signal (Appendix C.5 ). The ρ ≲ 0.15 \rho\lesssim 0.15 diagnostic flags the observed failure regimes while remaining positive for discriminative settings (NIH 0.523 0.523 , CheXpert 0.298 0.298 ); when flagged, MC-Dropout or ensembles are preferable, with MUS retained as a fusion component. Thus, the primary operating regime is low-cost failure detection for overconfident multi-label classifiers under moderate shift when retraining is infeasible. Generalization beyond radiography and RGB natural images remains untested.
paragraphs.zh: SpatialUQ 存在五个主要局限性。 (i) 严重的领域偏移可能导致不一致性信号失效（VinBigData，ρ = 0.027 \rho=0.027）。 (ii) 五个固定裁剪限制了模型对小焦点病变的敏感性（Nodule JSD AUC 0.368 0.368；16 裁剪扩展：0.589 0.589）。 (iii) ViT 的全局注意力机制压缩了 MUS 的动态范围，而掩码处理可恢复 +0.004 +0.004 AUC（附录 C.4）。 (iv) 融合方法需要一个带标签的预留数据集。 (v) 使用全局池化的生成式 VLM 可能会削弱该信号（附录 C.5）。 ρ ≲ 0.15 \rho\lesssim 0.15 的诊断指标可标记出观察到的失效模式，同时在对判别性设置中仍保持阳性（NIH 0.523 0.523，CheXpert 0.298 0.298）；当被标记时，优先采用 MC-Dropout 或集成方法，同时保留 MUS 作为融合组件。 因此，其主要适用场景是在中等领域偏移且无法重新训练的情况下，对过度自信的多元标签分类器进行低成本失效检测。 在放射影像和 RGB 自然图像之外的泛化能力尚未得到验证。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 compares SpatialUQ with established UQ methods on NIH DenseNet-121. MUS achieves 0.784 0.784 AUC fully post-hoc, without retraining, training data, or architectural modifications, while competitive baselines require training-time structure (MC-Dropout, ensembles) or dataset-dependent statistics (DDU, Mahalanobis). Extended analysis appears in Appendix K . Temperature scaling improves ensemble SCE from 0.138 0.138 to 0.090 0.090 but reduces AUC from 0.813 0.813 to 0.774 0.774 , illustrating the trade-off between calibration and discrimination. Fusion reaches 0.832 0.832 AUC by adding the spatially grounded MUS signal, whose native SCE is 0.049 0.049 .
paragraphs.zh: 表 5 在 NIH DenseNet-121 上比较了 SpatialUQ 与成熟的 UQ 方法。 MUS 无需重新训练、训练数据或架构修改，即可在完全事后分析中实现 0.784 0.784 的 AUC，而具有竞争力的基线方法则需要训练时的结构（MC-Dropout、集成）或依赖数据集的统计量（DDU、马氏距离）。 扩展分析见附录 K。 温度缩放将集成 SCE 从 0.138 0.138 提升至 0.090 0.090，但使 AUC 从 0.813 0.813 降至 0.774 0.774，这体现了校准与区分能力之间的权衡。 通过添加基于空间信息的 MUS 信号（其原始 SCE 为 0.049 0.049），融合方法实现了 0.832 0.832 的 AUC。

paragraphs.en: SpatialUQ provides a practical operating point for inference-time failure detection: six deterministic forward passes using output probabilities alone, with no access to model internals, labels or retraining. Spatial inconsistency provides a geometrically grounded signal that scales with model quality, from 0.784 0.784 AUC on DenseNet-121 to 0.899 0.899 on BiomedCLIP ( ρ = 0.846 \rho=0.846 ). The ρ ≲ 0.15 \rho\lesssim 0.15 diagnostic further provides a simple pre-deployment check for the observed distribution-shift failure regimes. Future work includes saliency-guided crop placement, aggregation adapted to global-attention architectures, and broader validation on MIMIC-CXR with temporal shift, population-level AURC, and intersectional subgroup analyzes. Generalization to CT, MRI, and ultrasound also remains to be established.
paragraphs.zh: SpatialUQ 为推理时的故障检测提供了一个实用的操作方案：仅使用输出概率进行六次确定性前向传播，无需访问模型内部结构、标签或重新训练。 空间不一致性提供了一种基于几何原理的信号，其效果会随模型质量提升而增强，从 DenseNet-121 上的 0.784 AUC 到 BiomedCLIP 上的 0.899 AUC（ρ = 0.846）。 ρ ≲ 0.15 的诊断指标进一步为观察到的分布偏移故障模式提供了一种简单的部署前检查方法。 未来的工作包括基于显著性引导的裁剪定位、适配全局注意力架构的聚合方法，以及在 MIMIC-CXR 数据集上针对时间偏移、人群级 AURC 和交叉子组分析进行更广泛的验证。 该方法在 CT、MRI 和超声影像上的泛化能力也仍有待验证。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 reports per-class AUC-ROC, Brier score, and average precision for the DenseNet-121 backbone (7.0 M parameters) trained on NIH ChestX-ray14, selected at epoch 28 (validation loss of 2.0564). The model achieves a mean AUC of 0.7885, with discriminative performance ranging from 0.6984 (Infiltration) to 0.8822 (Emphysema). Calibration and average precision exhibit pronounced class-level disparity, largely attributable to severe label imbalance. These results serve as the reference operating point for the subsequent failure-detection analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 表6报告了基于DenseNet-121骨干网络（700万参数）在NIH ChestX-ray14数据集上训练所得的每个类别的AUC-ROC、Brier得分和平均精度，该模型在第28个训练周期被选中（验证损失为2.0564）。 该模型的平均AUC达到0.7885，其区分能力在0.6984（浸润）至0.8822（肺气肿）之间变化。 校准和平均精度表现出显著的类别级差异，这主要归因于严重的标签不平衡问题。 这些结果将作为后续故障检测分析的参考基准点。

paragraphs.en: Table 7 reports per-class AUC-ROC, Brier score, and average precision for the EfficientNet-B4 backbone (17.6 M parameters) on NIH ChestX-ray14, selected at epoch 29 (validation loss 2.0793). The model achieves a mean AUC of 0.7347, trailing DenseNet-121 by 0.054 points despite nearly 2.5 × 2.5\times more parameters, with per-class AUC ranging from 0.6589 (Pneumonia) to 0.8093 (Edema). Calibration and average precision mirror the class-imbalance patterns observed in the DenseNet-121 baseline. Both backbones are subsequently treated as frozen black-boxes for post-hoc uncertainty evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 表7报告了EfficientNet-B4骨干网络（1760万个参数）在NIH ChestX-ray14数据集上、于第29个训练周期（验证损失为2.0793）时，各类别的AUC-ROC、Brier得分和平均精度。 该模型的平均AUC为0.7347，比DenseNet-121低0.054分，尽管其参数数量接近后者的2.5倍；各类别的AUC范围从0.6589（肺炎）到0.8093（水肿）。 校准结果和平均精度反映了在DenseNet-121基线模型中观察到的类别不平衡模式。 随后，这两种骨干网络均被视作冻结的黑箱，用于事后不确定性评估。

paragraphs.en: The results in Table 9 evaluate failure detection performance on the NIH ChestX-ray14 test set using a DenseNet-121 backbone. Failure is defined as predictions with Brier score exceeding the 75th percentile (threshold = 0.5607, yielding a 25% failure rate). We report area under the ROC curve (AUC) with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals (1,000 resamples) and Score Calibration Error (SCE)the expected calibration error applied to min–max normalized scores using 15 bins. Among all methods, the proposed MUS achieves the lowest SCE (0.0487), indicating well-calibrated failure probabilities, while its AUC (0.7837) is competitive. The highest AUC is obtained by Fusion CV (0.8319), which combines multiple uncertainty signals, followed closely by the two Auditor variants (0.8250, 0.8242). However, these top AUC methods exhibit substantially higher SCE (0.2464, 0.2408, 0.2363) than MUS. Deep Ensemble (5 members) yields strong AUC (0.8130) and moderate SCE (0.1379), whereas MUS strikes a favorable trade-off with near-perfect calibration. Notably, simple post-hoc baselines like T-Scaled Confidence -1 achieve excellent SCE (0.0015) but near-random AUC (0.4000), highlighting that calibration alone is insufficient for failure detection. Conversely, Entropy performs poorly on both metrics (AUC 0.1774, SCE 0.4575). Methods marked with † \dagger require more than six forward passes or training-time modifications; ‡ \ddagger indicates access to training-set features. The table confirms that no single method dominates all criteria, but MUS provides the best calibration among practically viable approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 表9中的结果使用DenseNet-121作为主干网络，在NIH ChestX-ray14测试集上评估了故障检测性能。 故障被定义为布里尔分数超过第75百分位数的预测（阈值 = 0.5607，对应25%的故障率）。 我们报告了ROC曲线下的面积（AUC）及其95%自助置信区间（1,000次重采样），以及评分校准误差（SCE）——即使用15个分箱对最小-最大归一化评分应用预期校准误差的结果。 在所有方法中，所提出的MUS实现了最低的SCE（0.0487），表明其故障概率经过良好校准，同时其AUC（0.7837）也具有竞争力。 最高的AUC由Fusion CV（0.8319）取得，该方法结合了多种不确定性信号；紧随其后的是两种Auditor变体（0.8250、0.8242）。 然而，这些AUC最高的方法表现出远高于MUS的SCE（0.2464、0.2408、0.2363）。 Deep Ensemble（5个成员）获得了较高的AUC（0.8130）和中等水平的SCE（0.1379），而MUS则在近乎完美的校准效果下实现了更优的权衡。 值得注意的是，像T-Scaled Confidence -1这样的简单后处理基线方法虽然实现了极低的SCE（0.0015），但AUC接近随机水平（0.4000），这表明仅靠校准不足以实现故障检测。 相反，Entropy在这两项指标上的表现均不佳（AUC 0.1774，SCE 0.4575）。 带有† \dagger标记的方法需要超过六次前向传播或进行训练时的修改；‡ \ddagger表示可以访问训练集特征。 该表证实没有单一方法在所有标准上都占据主导地位，但在实际可行的方法中，MUS提供了最佳的校准效果。

paragraphs.en: Table 10 demonstrates that MUS exhibits strong robustness to random initialization, with AUC values remaining tightly clustered across different seeds (0.7826–0.7902), indicating low variance and stable behavior. The fluctuation range (0.0076) is minimal, suggesting that MUS is not sensitive to stochastic training effects and generalizes consistently. In comparison, ℓ 1 \ell_{1} Distance achieves slightly higher absolute performance across all seeds but follows a similar stability pattern, while MC-Dropout and TTA Variance show modest variability and consistently lower AUC. Notably, confidence-based and entropy-based methods remain significantly weaker and exhibit inconsistent behavior across seeds, highlighting their limited reliability. Pairwise JSD also shows mild degradation for certain seeds, suggesting sensitivity to randomness in feature representations. Overall, these results reinforce that MUS provides a reliable and reproducible uncertainty signal, maintaining competitive performance with minimal seed-induced variance an important property for deployment in high-stakes settings.
paragraphs.zh: 表 10 表明，MUS 对随机初始化具有很强的鲁棒性，不同种子下的 AUC 值始终紧密聚集（0.7826–0.7902），说明其方差较低且行为稳定。 波动范围（0.0076）极小，这表明 MUS 对随机训练效应不敏感，并能保持一致的泛化能力。 相比之下，ℓ₁ 距离在所有种子下都实现了略高的绝对性能，但呈现出相似的稳定模式；而 MC-Dropout 和 TTA Variance 则表现出中等程度的变异性，且 AUC 始终较低。 值得注意的是，基于置信度和熵的方法表现明显更弱，并在不同种子下展现出不一致的行为，凸显了其可靠性有限。 成对 JSD 在某些种子下也出现了轻微的性能下降，表明其对特征表示中的随机性较为敏感。 总体而言，这些结果进一步证明，MUS 能够提供可靠且可重复的不确定性信号，在保持竞争力的同时，将种子引起的方差降至最低——这是其在高风险场景部署中的重要特性。

paragraphs.en: To assess SpatialUQ’s transferability and scaling with model quality, we evaluate CLIP ViT-B/32 and BiomedCLIP on the NIH ChestX-ray14 test set with a linear probe trained on NIH train features (backbone frozen; no fine-tuning). Labels are used only to train the probe and for evaluation. Table 11 reports failure detection AUC (75th percentile Brier threshold, 25% failure rate), 95% bootstrap CIs, and raw Score Calibration Error (SCE).
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估 SpatialUQ 在不同模型质量下的迁移性和可扩展性，我们在 NIH ChestX-ray14 测试集上对 CLIP ViT-B/32 和 BiomedCLIP 进行了评估，其中线性探测器是在 NIH 训练特征上训练的（主干网络冻结；未进行微调）。 标签仅用于训练探测器和进行评估。 表 11 报告了故障检测的 AUC（第 75 百分位数的 Brier 阈值，25% 的故障率）、95% 的自助置信区间以及原始分数校准误差（SCE）。

sents.zh: 为了评估 SpatialUQ 在不同模型质量下的迁移性和可扩展性，我们在 NIH ChestX-ray14 测试集上对 CLIP ViT-B/32 和 BiomedCLIP 进行了评估，其中线性探测器是在 NIH 训练特征上训练的（主干网络冻结；未进行微调）。

paragraphs.en: MUS achieves competitive failure detection across both models, with AUC improving from 0.825 0.825 (CLIP) to 0.899 0.899 (BiomedCLIP). This scaling is accompanied by an increase in Spearman correlation between MUS and per-image Brier score ( ρ = 0.631 \rho=0.631 for CLIP, ρ = 0.846 \rho=0.846 for BiomedCLIP), consistent with the hypothesis that better spatial representations yield stronger spatial consistency signals. Under linear-probe transfer, MUS’s calibration remains moderate (SCE 0.10 0.10 - 0.13 0.13 ) and superior to the raw L 1 L_{1} baseline ( 0.115 0.115 - 0.232 0.232 ). L 1 L_{1} and fusion achieve higher AUC but rely on a labeled hold-out for calibration (fusion) or would need isotonic regression ( L 1 L_{1} ) to produce reliable thresholds, options not always available in frozen black-box deployment. MUS therefore offers a label-free, natively calibrated uncertainty score that scales favorably with foundation model strength.
paragraphs.zh: MUS 在两种模型中都实现了具有竞争力的故障检测能力，其 AUC 从 0.825（CLIP）提升至 0.899（BiomedCLIP）。 这种性能提升伴随着 MUS 与每张图像 Brier 分数之间的 Spearman 相关性增强（CLIP 的 ρ = 0.631，BiomedCLIP 的 ρ = 0.846），这与“更优的空间表示能产生更强的空间一致性信号”这一假设一致。 在线性探针迁移设置下，MUS 的校准表现保持适中（SCE 为 0.10 - 0.13），优于原始 L₁ 基线模型（0.115 - 0.232）。 L₁ 和融合模型虽然实现了更高的 AUC，但前者依赖带标签的预留数据进行校准，后者则需要通过等音调回归才能获得可靠的阈值；而在冻结的黑箱部署环境中，这些方法并不总是可用。 因此，MUS 提供了一种无需标签、具备原生校准能力的置信度评分，且其性能能随着基础模型能力的增强而显著提升。

sents.en: L 1 L_{1} and fusion achieve higher AUC but rely on a labeled hold-out for calibration (fusion) or would need isotonic regression ( L 1 L_{1} ) to produce reliable thresholds, options not always available in frozen black-box deployment.
sents.zh: L₁ 和融合模型虽然实现了更高的 AUC，但前者依赖带标签的预留数据进行校准，后者则需要通过等音调回归才能获得可靠的阈值；而在冻结的黑箱部署环境中，这些方法并不总是可用。

sents.en: MUS therefore offers a label-free, natively calibrated uncertainty score that scales favorably with foundation model strength.
sents.zh: 因此，MUS 提供了一种无需标签、具备原生校准能力的置信度评分，且其性能能随着基础模型能力的增强而显著提升。

paragraphs.en: The results in Table 14 show that the impact of spatial aggregation strategy is strongly architecture-dependent. For convolutional backbones, upsampling consistently outperforms masking, with DenseNet-121 exhibiting a modest drop ( Δ = − 0.0141 \Delta=-0.0141 ) and EfficientNet-B4 showing a substantial degradation ( Δ = − 0.2251 \Delta=-0.2251 ) under masking. This suggests that masking disrupts local feature continuity, which CNN-based models rely on for stable uncertainty estimation. In contrast, ViT-B/16 demonstrates the opposite trend: masking yields a slight improvement in failure detection performance ( Δ = + 0.0045 \Delta=+0.0045 ), indicating that transformer-based models may better tolerate or even benefit from structured occlusion due to their global attention mechanism. Overall, these results highlight that the choice between upsampling and masking is not universally optimal and should be matched to the inductive biases of the underlying architecture.
paragraphs.zh: 表14中的结果表明，空间聚合策略的影响强烈依赖于模型架构。 对于卷积骨干网络，上采样始终优于掩码处理：在掩码处理下，DenseNet-121仅出现轻微下降（Δ = −0.0141），而EfficientNet-B4则表现出显著的性能退化（Δ = −0.2251）。 这表明掩码处理破坏了局部特征的连续性，而基于CNN的模型正是依赖这种连续性来实现稳定的不确定性估计。 相比之下，ViT-B/16呈现出相反的趋势：掩码处理略微提升了故障检测性能（Δ = +0.0045），说明基于Transformer的模型可能因其全局注意力机制而更能容忍甚至受益于结构化的遮挡。 总体而言，这些结果表明，上采样与掩码处理之间的选择并非普适最优，而应根据底层架构的归纳偏置进行匹配。

paragraphs.en: Table 15 reports SpatialUQ applied to BioViL-T, a generative vision-language model whose image encoder produces globally pooled cross-modal representations designed for image-text alignment rather than spatial discrimination. MUS collapses to 0.533 0.533 AUC (Spearman ρ = − 0.187 \rho{=}{-}0.187 ), correctly flagged by the ρ ≲ 0.15 \rho\lesssim 0.15 diagnostic as a known failure regime. This result is consistent with the mechanism described in Section 6 : spatial inconsistency requires architectures with spatially grounded feature extraction; globally pooled representations eliminate the crop-level inconsistency gradient MUS relies upon . Fusion recovers to 0.838 0.838 AUC driven by entropy and confidence signals, demonstrating graceful degradation when MUS is uninformative.
paragraphs.zh: 表15报告了将SpatialUQ应用于BioViL-T的结果，该模型是一种生成式视觉-语言模型，其图像编码器产生全局池化的跨模态表示，这种表示专为图像与文本对齐而设计，而非用于空间区分。 MUS降至0.533（AUC为0.533，Spearman ρ = − 0.187），被ρ ≲ 0.15的诊断标准正确识别为一个已知的失效区间。 这一结果与第6节中描述的机制一致：空间不一致性需要具有空间基础特征提取能力的架构；全局池化表示消除了MUS所依赖的裁剪层级不一致性梯度。 融合性能恢复至0.838（AUC为0.838），这是由熵和置信度信号驱动的，表明当MUS无法提供有效信息时，模型仍能表现出优雅的退化特性。

paragraphs.en: Architectural interpretation. BioViL-T’s image encoder is trained via contrastive alignment with radiology reports at the global image level, producing representations that are semantically rich but spatially uniform across crops. Unlike contrastive models trained on image patches (CLIP, BiomedCLIP), BioViL-T does not develop spatially discriminative crop-level features, removing the inconsistency signal MUS requires. This finding clarifies the architectural precondition for SpatialUQ: the model must produce spatially varying representations across sub-regions, a property present in CNNs and patch-based contrastive ViTs but absent in globally pooled generative VLMs. Practitioners can verify this precondition in under one minute using the ρ \rho diagnostic on a small unlabeled sample before committing to MUS-based deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 架构解读。 BioViL-T 的图像编码器通过在全局图像层面上与放射科报告进行对比对齐训练，从而生成语义丰富但在不同裁剪区域中空间分布均匀的特征表示。 与在图像块上训练的对比模型（CLIP、BiomedCLIP）不同，BioViL-T 无法形成具有空间区分能力的裁剪级特征，因此缺少 MUS 所依赖的不一致性信号。 这一发现阐明了 SpatialUQ 的架构前提条件：模型必须在子区域间生成具有空间变化的特征表示；CNN 和基于图像块的对比 ViT 具备这一特性，而全局池化的生成式 VLM 则不具备。 从业者可以在部署 MUS 方案之前，使用 ρ \rho 诊断方法在小规模未标注样本上验证这一前提条件，整个过程不到一分钟即可完成。

paragraphs.en: Table 16 reports per-class failure detection AUC using the class-specific JSD score for DenseNet-121, with per-class failure defined as Brier score exceeding the 75th percentile of each class’s marginal distribution. JSD AUC varies markedly across pathologies, from 0.9789 0.9789 (Pneumonia) to 0.3680 0.3680 (Nodule), revealing a strong dependence on spatial extent: diffuse findings such as Pneumonia, Edema, and Consolidation consistently achieve JSD AUC ≥ 0.95 \geq 0.95 , whereas small focal lesions Nodule ( 0.368 0.368 ), Fibrosis ( 0.553 0.553 ), and Mass ( 0.558 0.558 ) fall well below the aggregate performance. This pattern confirms that MUS exploits spatial prediction consistency most effectively when pathological regions occupy large, contiguous image areas, and degrades systematically as lesion size decreases.
paragraphs.zh: 表16报告了DenseNet-121使用类别特定的JSD分数计算出的每类故障检测AUC，其中每类故障定义为布里尔分数超过该类边缘分布第75百分位数的情况。 JSD AUC在不同病理类型间差异显著：从肺炎的0.9789到结节状的0.3680，这表明其性能强烈依赖于病变的空间范围：肺炎、水肿和实变等弥漫性病变始终能达到JSD AUC ≥ 0.95，而结节（0.368）、纤维化（0.553）和肿块（0.558）等小型局灶性病变则远低于整体性能水平。 这一模式证实了MUS在病理区域占据大面积连续图像区域时能最有效地利用空间预测一致性，而当病变尺寸减小时，其性能会系统性地下降。

paragraphs.en: Table 17 reports per-class JSD AUC for EfficientNet-B4 on NIH ChestX-ray14. In contrast to DenseNet-121, all 14 classes fall within a narrow band of 0.75-0.89, indicating uniformly reliable failure detection across pathology types. Most strikingly, Nodule JSD AUC rises to 0.8822 compared to 0.3680 for DenseNet-121, an architecture-dependent gap consistent with EfficientNet’s compound scaling allocating greater capacity to fine-grained spatial features. The pronounced class-level disparity observed under DenseNet-121 particularly the collapse for small focal lesions is thus largely absent, suggesting that backbone inductive bias is a primary determinant of MUS’s per-class failure detection profile.
paragraphs.zh: 表 17 报告了 EfficientNet-B4 在 NIH ChestX-ray14 数据集上每个类别的 JSD AUC。 与 DenseNet-121 不同，所有 14 个类别都落在 0.75-0.89 这一狭窄区间内，表明其跨病理类型的故障检测能力均匀且可靠。 最引人注目的是，结节类别的 JSD AUC 提升至 0.8822，而 DenseNet-121 仅为 0.3680；这一架构相关的差距与 EfficientNet 的复合缩放机制将更多计算资源分配给精细空间特征的特性一致。 因此，在 DenseNet-121 中观察到的显著类别间差异——尤其是小病灶区域的性能骤降——在此基本不存在，这表明主干网络的归纳偏置是 MUS 各故障检测类别表现的主要决定因素。

paragraphs.en: Table 18 reports per-class JSD AUC for ViT-B/16 on NIH ChestX-ray14. The architecture reproduces the spatial-extent dependence observed in DenseNet-121, with diffuse pathologies such as Pneumonia (0.88) and Edema (0.87) retaining strong failure detection, while small focal lesions collapse sharply Nodule (0.3037), Mass (0.4182), and Emphysema (0.4024). We attribute this degradation to ViT’s global self-attention, which produces spatially coherent crop-level predictions regardless of lesion localisation, thereby compressing the inconsistency signal that MUS relies upon. Notably, even Pneumothorax (0.74) and Hernia (0.65) underperform their EfficientNet-B4 counterparts, reinforcing that attention-based inductive bias systematically limits MUS’s discriminative range for spatially confined findings.
paragraphs.zh: 表18报告了ViT-B/16在NIH ChestX-ray14数据集上每个类别的JSD AUC。 该架构再现了DenseNet-121中观察到的空间范围依赖性：弥漫性病变（如肺炎，0.88和肺水肿，0.87）仍保持较强的失败检测能力，而小型局灶性病变（如结节，0.3037；肿块，0.4182；肺气肿，0.4024）则急剧下降。 我们将这种性能退化归因于ViT的全局自注意力机制：无论病变位于何处，它都会生成空间上连贯的裁剪级预测，从而压缩了MUS所依赖的不一致性信号。 值得注意的是，甚至肺气胸（0.74）和疝气（0.65）的表现也低于其EfficientNet-B4对应模型，这进一步表明基于注意力的归纳偏置系统性地限制了MUS对空间范围受限病变的判别能力。

paragraphs.en: Table 19 reports per-class JSD AUC for zero-shot transfer of the NIH-trained DenseNet-121 to CheXpert ( N = 44,399 N{=}44{,}399 , 10 mapped classes). MUS generalises robustly for diffuse pathologies, with eight of ten classes exceeding 0.71, led by Pneumonia (0.9678) and Pleural Thickening (0.9675). Nodule, however, degrades severely to 0.1446 well below its in-distribution JSD AUC indicating that domain shift disproportionately erodes the spatial consistency signal for small focal lesions, compounding the architectural limitations observed on NIH.
paragraphs.zh: 表19报告了将NIH训练的DenseNet-121零样本迁移到CheXpert（N = 44,399 N{=}44{,}399，10个映射类别）时每个类别的JSD AUC。 MUS在弥漫性病变上表现出稳健的泛化能力，其中十个类别中有八个超过了0.71，以肺炎（0.9678）和胸膜增厚（0.9675）为首。 然而，结节类别的性能严重下降至0.1446，远低于其在数据分布内的JSD AUC，这表明域偏移不成比例地削弱了小范围局灶性病变的空间一致性信号，进一步加剧了在NIH上观察到的架构局限性。

paragraphs.en: Table 20 reports per-class JSD AUC for zero-shot transfer to VinBigData ( N = 15,000 N{=}15{,}000 , 10 mapped classes). Performance bifurcates sharply: Atelectasis (0.9467), Infiltration (0.9222), and Pneumothorax (0.9181) retain strong failure detection, while Consolidation (0.3375), Mass (0.1644), and Nodule (0.1608) collapse near chance. Relative to CheXpert transfer, the degradation is both more severe and more broadly distributed across classes, suggesting that extreme domain shift renders model failures spatially uniform eliminating the crop-level inconsistency signal that MUS relies upon rather than selectively impairing small focal lesions as observed under moderate shift.
paragraphs.zh: 表20报告了针对VinBigData（N = 15,000 N{=}15{,}000，10个映射类别）的零样本迁移中每个类别的JSD AUC。 性能出现急剧分化：肺不张（0.9467）、浸润（0.9222）和气胸（0.9181）仍保持较强的故障检测能力，而肺实变（0.3375）、肿块（0.1644）和结节（0.1608）的性能则降至接近随机水平。 与CheXpert迁移相比，性能下降不仅更为严重，而且在各类别中的分布也更广泛。这表明极端的域偏移使模型故障在空间上趋于均匀，从而消除了MUS所依赖的作物层级不一致性信号，而非像在中度偏移下观察到的那样选择性地损害小的局灶性病变。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate whether the discriminative power of MUS is dependent on specific geometric coordinates, we conducted a control experiment substituting the fixed five-crop set with 1,000 randomly sampled 112 × 112 112\times 112 crops. This configuration yielded a failure detection AUC of 0.7389 0.7389 , compared to 0.784 0.784 for the standard fixed-crop MUS. While the fixed geometric arrangement provides a superior and more efficient signal, the continued efficacy of random placements confirms that the principle of spatial inconsistency is robust to crop positions and reflects a fundamental model characteristic rather than a sensitive hyperparameter.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估 MUS 的区分能力是否依赖于特定的几何坐标，我们进行了一项对照实验，用 1,000 个随机采样的 112 × 112 图像块替换了固定的五个图像块集合。 这种配置产生的故障检测 AUC 为 0.7389，而标准固定图像块 MUS 的 AUC 为 0.784。 尽管固定的几何排列提供了更优且更高效的信号，但随机放置方式依然有效，这证实了空间不一致性原则对图像块位置具有鲁棒性，并体现了模型的一项基本特性，而非一个敏感的超参数。

paragraphs.en: Table 21 reports MUS failure detection AUC on NIH DenseNet-121 as a function of the number of spatial crops. Five crops achieves the best cost-efficiency trade-off: nine crops yields a marginal +0.007 AUC improvement (0.7902 vs. 0.7837) at 67% more inference cost, while three crops reduces AUC by 0.007 (0.7764 vs. 0.7837). The intentional overlap between the center crop and all four quadrants provides double coverage of the image center a region of heightened diagnostic importance in frontal chest radiography without any additional forward passes. The apparent reversal at K=4 (AUC = 0.7859 > K=5 AUC = 0.7837) is not statistically meaningful: the difference of 0.0022 lies well within the 95% bootstrap CI width of ±0.006 for MUS on this dataset (bootstrap p > 0.3). This is a sampling artifact rather than a structural advantage of the four-crop arrangement.
paragraphs.zh: 表21报告了NIH DenseNet-121模型上MUS故障检测的AUC值随空间裁剪数量变化的情况。 五次裁剪实现了最佳的成本效率权衡：九次裁剪带来的AUC提升仅为微弱的+0.007（0.7902对比0.7837），但推理成本增加了67%；而三次裁剪则使AUC降低了0.007（0.7764对比0.7837）。 中心裁剪与四个象限之间的有意重叠，无需任何额外的前向传播，即可对图像中心区域——在前胸X光片诊断中至关重要的区域——实现双重覆盖。 K=4时出现的表面上的反转（AUC = 0.7859 > K=5时的AUC = 0.7837）在统计学上并无显著意义：0.0022的差异完全处于该数据集上MUS的95%自助置信区间宽度±0.006范围内（自助p值 > 0.3）。 这是一种采样造成的伪影，而非四次裁剪布局的结构性优势。

sents.en: Table 21 reports MUS failure detection AUC on NIH DenseNet-121 as a function of the number of spatial crops.
sents.zh: 表21报告了NIH DenseNet-121模型上MUS故障检测的AUC值随空间裁剪数量变化的情况。

sents.en: Five crops achieves the best cost-efficiency trade-off: nine crops yields a marginal +0.007 AUC improvement (0.7902 vs. 0.7837) at 67% more inference cost, while three crops reduces AUC by 0.007 (0.7764 vs. 0.7837).

paragraphs.en: The non-monotonic AUC curve in Table 21 (dipping at K=6 before recovering at K=7 and K=9) reflects a geometric property of fixed crop placement. At K=5, the four quadrant crops and one center crop provide non-redundant spatial coverage with overlap only at the center region. Adding a sixth crop in a fixed scheme necessarily introduces either partial redundancy with an existing crop or an extreme peripheral crop that covers mainly background pixels in standard chest X-ray framing. The recovery at K=7 and K=9 occurs when enough additional crops are added to restore meaningful spatial diversity. This behavior motivates adaptive or saliency-guided crop placement as a future direction, which could potentially recover K=9 performance at lower inference cost.
paragraphs.zh: 表21中非单调的AUC曲线（在K=6时下降，随后在K=7和K=9时恢复）反映了固定裁剪位置的一种几何特性。 在K=5时，四个象限裁剪和一个中心裁剪提供了无冗余的空间覆盖，仅在中心区域存在重叠。 按照固定方案添加第六个裁剪必然会导致与现有裁剪的部分冗余，或者产生一个极端边缘的裁剪，在标准胸部X光片构图下主要覆盖背景像素。 当添加足够多的额外裁剪以恢复有意义的空间多样性时，K=7和K=9处的性能才得以恢复。 这种行为促使我们将自适应或显著性引导的裁剪位置作为未来研究方向，这或许能在更低的推理成本下恢复K=9的性能。

paragraphs.en: Beyond AUC, as we can see from Figure 7 , the five crop design is geometrically motivated. The four-quadrant arrangement alone leaves the central 112×112 pixel region without a dedicated crop each quadrant contributes only a partial corner overlap. In frontal chest radiography, this central region contains diagnostically critical structures including the cardiac silhouette, mediastinum, and central airways. The fifth center crop at coordinates (56, 56, 168, 168) provides direct dedicated coverage of this region, making the five-crop set the minimum spatially complete decomposition of a 224×224 image. K=4 cannot be considered spatially complete regardless of its AUC on any single dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 除了 AUC 之外，从图 7 中我们可以看到，五种裁剪方案在几何上是有依据的。 仅靠四象限布局会使中央的 112×112 像素区域没有专属的裁剪区域，每个象限仅能贡献部分角部重叠。 在前位胸片 X 光检查中，这一中心区域包含诊断上至关重要的结构，包括心脏轮廓、纵隔和中央气道。 位于坐标 (56, 56, 168, 168) 的第五个中心裁剪区域直接覆盖该区域，因此五种裁剪的组合构成了对 224×224 图像在空间上最完整的分解。 无论其在任何单个数据集上的 AUC 如何，K=4 都不能被视为在空间上完整的划分。

paragraphs.en: Table 22 evaluates failure detection performance under increasingly stringent definitions of failure, revealing clear stratification across uncertainty estimation methods. As expected, naive baselines such as Random remain at chance level, while confidence-based proxies (Confidence -1 , Entropy) perform poorly and degrade further at higher thresholds, indicating limited alignment with true model errors. Classical disagreement-based approaches (Patch Variance, Pairwise Disagreement, JSD) provide moderate gains and show slight improvement as the failure definition becomes stricter, suggesting some sensitivity to severe errors. Among single-model uncertainty methods, ℓ 1 \ell_{1} Distance and ODIN demonstrate strong performance, particularly at higher thresholds, while TTA-based and MC-Dropout methods degrade, reflecting instability under stricter failure criteria. Ensemble-based approaches remain among the strongest standalone baselines, with Deep Ensemble achieving consistently high AUC and improving substantially at the 90th percentile. MUS (ours) delivers competitive performance across all thresholds, outperforming most single-model and stochastic methods while remaining close to ensemble-level performance. Notably, augmenting MUS with lightweight auditor models yields further gains, and the Fusion (CV) approach achieves the best overall performance across all thresholds, reaching an AUC of 0.8712 at the 90th percentile. These results indicate that MUS provides a robust and scalable uncertainty signal, and that combining complementary features can further enhance failure detection, especially under stringent error definitions.
paragraphs.zh: 表22评估了在日益严格的故障定义下故障检测的性能，揭示了不同不确定性估计方法之间的明显分层。 正如预期，像Random这样的朴素基线模型表现始终处于随机水平，而基于置信度的代理指标（Confidence -1、Entropy）表现不佳，并且在更高阈值下进一步下降，表明它们与真实模型错误的一致性有限。 经典的基于分歧的方法（Patch Variance、Pairwise Disagreement、JSD）带来了中等程度的提升，并且随着故障定义的严格化而略有改善，这表明它们对严重错误具有一定的敏感性。 在单模型不确定性方法中，ℓ₁距离和ODIN表现出强劲的性能，尤其是在更高阈值下；而基于TTA和MC-Dropout的方法则表现下降，反映出它们在更严格的故障标准下存在不稳定性。 基于集成模型的方法仍然是最强的独立基线模型之一，其中Deep Ensemble实现了持续的高AUC，并在第90百分位处显著提升。 MUS（我们的方法）在所有阈值下都展现出具有竞争力的性能，优于大多数单模型和随机方法，同时其表现接近集成模型水平。 值得注意的是，通过为MUS添加轻量级审计模型可以进一步提升性能，而Fusion（CV）方法在所有阈值下均实现了最佳整体性能，在第90百分位处的AUC达到了0.8712。 这些结果表明，MUS能够提供稳健且可扩展的不确定性信号，并且结合互补特征可以进一步增强故障检测能力，尤其是在严格的错误定义条件下。

paragraphs.en: The monotonic increase of MUS AUC with Brier threshold stringency (0.770 → 0.784 → 0.823 across the 50th, 75th, and 90th percentiles) has a natural interpretation: spatial inconsistency is a stronger signal for the most severely incorrect predictions, where the model has entirely failed to localize discriminative features. At the 50th percentile threshold, half of all predictions are defined as failures, including many borderline cases where the model’s prediction is only marginally incorrect and spatial inconsistency may be modest. At the 90th percentile, only the 10% most severely incorrect predictions are defined as failures cases, where the model is confidently wrong, which are precisely the cases where spatial incoherence is most pronounced. This monotonicity is preserved on CheXpert (0.647 → 0.708 → 0.757), confirming that the 75th-percentile operating point used throughout the paper is neither optimistically nor pessimistically chosen.
paragraphs.zh: MUS AUC 随着布里尔阈值严格度的提高而单调递增（在第 50、75 和 90 百分位上分别为 0.770 → 0.784 → 0.823），这一现象有其自然的解释：空间不一致性对于错误最严重的预测而言是一种更强的信号，在这些情况下，模型完全未能定位出具有区分性的特征。 在第 50 百分位阈值下，所有预测中有一半被定义为失败，其中包括许多临界情况——在这些情况下，模型的预测仅存在轻微错误，且空间不一致性可能并不显著。 在第 90 百分位时，只有错误最严重的 10% 的预测被定义为失败案例；在这些案例中，模型明确判断错误，而这恰恰是空间不协调性最为突出的情况。 这种单调性在 CheXpert 数据集上同样成立（0.647 → 0.708 → 0.757），证实了本文全程使用的第 75 百分位操作点既非过于乐观，也非过于悲观的选择。

paragraphs.en: Table 23 reports a leave-one-out ablation of the four-feature fusion for NIH DenseNet-121, where each feature is removed in turn from the full fusion (AUC of = 0.8319 =0.8319 ) to quantify its marginal contribution. Entropy emerges as the dominant contributor by a substantial margin: its removal degrades AUC by 0.0437 0.0437 , reducing the fusion to 0.7881 0.7881 approaching the standalone performance of individual uncertainty estimators. ℓ 1 \ell_{1} Distance and MUS each provide modest but non-redundant complementary signal ( − 0.0071 -0.0071 and − 0.0053 -0.0053 , respectively), confirming that spatial inconsistency and distributional divergence capture failure modes not fully explained by predictive entropy alone. Confidence contributes negligibly ( − 0.0010 -0.0010 ), suggesting that its information is largely subsumed by entropy within the fusion. Collectively, these results indicate that fusion performance is primarily driven by entropy, with MUS and ℓ 1 \ell_{1} Distance providing independent secondary contributions that collectively account for the gap between entropy-only and full-fusion performance.
paragraphs.zh: 表23报告了NIH DenseNet-121中四特征融合的留一法消融分析，其中每个特征依次从完整融合中移除（AUC为=0.8319 =0.8319），以量化其边际贡献。 熵以显著优势成为主导贡献因素：移除熵会使AUC下降0.0437 0.0437，使融合性能降至0.7881 0.7881，接近单个不确定性估计器的独立表现。ℓ₁ \ell_{1}距离和MUS各自提供了适度但非冗余的互补信号（分别为−0.0071 -0.0071和−0.0053 -0.0053），证实了空间不一致性和分布差异能够捕捉到仅凭预测熵无法完全解释的失效模式。 置信度的贡献可忽略不计（−0.0010 -0.0010），表明其信息在融合过程中基本已被熵所涵盖。 综合来看，这些结果表明融合性能主要由熵驱动，而MUS和ℓ₁ \ell_{1}距离则提供了独立的次要贡献，二者共同解释了仅使用熵与完整融合性能之间的差距。

paragraphs.en: Table 24 reports the leave-one-out fusion ablation for ViT-B/16 (full fusion AUC = 0.8314 =0.8314 ). Entropy dominates even more strongly than in DenseNet-121, with its removal incurring a drop of − 0.0780 -0.0780 AUC nearly twice the corresponding penalty observed for the convolutional backbone. ℓ 1 \ell_{1} Distance and MUS contribute marginally ( − 0.0022 -0.0022 and − 0.0015 -0.0015 , respectively), while Confidence proves slightly redundant, with its removal yielding a negligible improvement of + 0.0014 +0.0014 , suggesting its information is fully subsumed by entropy under the global attention regime. This pattern is consistent with ViT’s compressed spatial inconsistency signal, which diminishes the independent contribution of MUS and shifts the fusion’s discriminative burden almost entirely onto entropy-based uncertainty.
paragraphs.zh: 表24报告了ViT-B/16的留一融合消融实验结果（完整融合AUC = 0.8314）。 熵的影响甚至比DenseNet-121中更为显著，移除熵会导致AUC下降−0.0780，几乎是卷积主干网络所观察到的相应惩罚的两倍。ℓ₁距离和MUS的贡献微乎其微（分别为−0.0022和−0.0015），而置信度则略显冗余，移除它仅带来+0.0014的微小提升，表明在全局注意力机制下，其信息已被熵完全涵盖。 这一模式与ViT压缩后的空间不一致性信号一致，该信号削弱了MUS的独立贡献，并将融合过程中的判别负担几乎完全转移到了基于熵的不确定性上。

paragraphs.en: Table 25 reports leave-one-out fusion ablations across three ImageNet-1k architectures, revealing a consistent reversal relative to the NIH chest X-ray setting: confidence is the dominant fusion signal in all three models, with removal penalties of − 0.0934 -0.0934 (ConvNeXt-Tiny), − 0.0407 -0.0407 (ViT-B/16), and − 0.0168 -0.0168 (EfficientNet-B4). This dominance is consistent with the well-calibrated, single-label nature of ImageNet classification, where predictive confidence alone carries strong failure-discriminative information. Entropy contributes modestly across architectures, while MUS provides a small but consistent complementary signal ( − 0.0035 -0.0035 to − 0.0056 -0.0056 ), with the exception of EfficientNet-B4 where entropy removal incurs no penalty ( ± 0.0000 \pm 0.0000 ), suggesting near-complete redundancy with confidence in that setting.

paragraphs.en: Clinical utility (CheXpert): Selective prediction at 20% referral improves system AUC from 0.6860 to 0.7478. Relative gap reduction: 19.7%. The drop in Spearman correlation between MUS and Brier score from 0.523 (NIH in-distribution) to 0.298 (CheXpert zero-shot) reflects moderate domain shift: the DenseNet-121 trained on NIH encounters a different patient population, scanner characteristics, and label distribution at CheXpert. Despite this, MUS retains meaningful discriminative power (AUC = 0.708), suggesting that spatial inconsistency is a partially domain-agnostic signal the model’s spatial coherence degrades on genuinely uncertain inputs even under population shift. The ECE of MUS on CheXpert (0.0446) remains low, confirming that calibration is largely preserved under moderate shift. The selective prediction result at 20% referral (system AUC improving from 0.686 to 0.748, a 19.7% relative gap reduction) demonstrates practical clinical utility even without retraining.
paragraphs.zh: 临床效用（CheXpert）：在 20% 转诊率下进行选择式预测，可将系统 AUC 从 0.6860 提升至 0.7478。 相对差距缩减：19.7%。 MUS 与 Brier 分数之间的 Spearman 相关性从 0.523（NIH 分布内数据）下降至 0.298（CheXpert 零样本测试），反映出中等程度的域偏移：在 NIH 数据集上训练的 DenseNet-121 在 CheXpert 中面临不同的患者群体、扫描仪特征和标签分布。 尽管如此，MUS 仍保留有意义的区分能力（AUC = 0.708），表明空间不一致性部分属于与域无关的信号——即使存在人口统计偏移，模型在真正不确定的输入上其空间一致性也会下降。 MUS 在 CheXpert 上的 ECE（0.0446）仍然较低，证实了在中等域偏移下校准效果基本得以保留。 20% 转诊率下的选择式预测结果（系统 AUC 从 0.686 提升至 0.748，相对差距缩减 19.7%）表明，即使无需重新训练，该模型仍具有实际临床效用。

paragraphs.en: Table 27 reports full metrics for VinBigData. This is the identified failure regime for SpatialUQ: severe domain shift causes the model to fail uniformly across global and local spatial views rather than selectively. Spearman ρ \rho (MUS vs. Brier) = 0.0269, p = 9.86 × 10 − 4 p=9.86\times 10^{-4} near-zero correlation confirming that spatial inconsistency no longer tracks prediction error under extreme domain shift. paragraphs.en: Despite MUS collapsing to near-chance on VinBigData (AUC = 0.614, Spearman ρ \rho = 0.027), the linear Fusion model retains 0.750 AUC. A leave-one-out analysis on the VinBigData 10% calibration split confirms that this gain is driven entirely by MC-Dropout (AUC contribution ≈ \approx 0.140) and entropy (contribution ≈ \approx 0.095), with MUS contributing negligibly ( ≈ \approx 0.002). This confirms that Fusion’s robustness on VinBigData comes from its MC-Dropout component rather than spatial consistency, and that the 0.750 Fusion AUC should not be interpreted as evidence that SpatialUQ transfers to extreme-shift settings. Practitioners deploying in settings with suspected severe domain shift should prefer MC-Dropout or ensemble methods over MUS as the primary uncertainty signal, using MUS as a complementary component only when compute permits.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 MUS 在 VinBigData 上的表现已接近随机水平（AUC = 0.614，Spearman ρ \rho = 0.027），但线性融合模型仍保持了 0.750 的 AUC。 对 VinBigData 10% 校准集进行的留一法分析证实，这种提升完全由 MC-Dropout（AUC 贡献值 ≈ \approx 0.140）和熵（贡献值 ≈ \approx 0.095）驱动，而 MUS 的贡献微乎其微（≈ \approx 0.002）。 这证实了 Fusion 在 VinBigData 上的稳健性源于其 MC-Dropout 组件而非空间一致性，并且 0.750 的 Fusion AUC 不应被解释为 SpatialUQ 能迁移到极端偏移场景的证据。 在存在严重领域偏移嫌疑的场景中，从业者应将 MC-Dropout 或集成方法作为主要不确定性信号优先于 MUS；仅在计算资源允许时，才可将 MUS 用作补充组件。

paragraphs.en: Table 28 reports full secondary metrics for failure detection on ImageNet-1k across three architectures. Confidence-inv is the dominant standalone signal, achieving AUC of 0.9132, 0.9233, and 0.9131 for EfficientNet-B4, ViT-B/16, and ConvNeXt-Tiny respectively, consistent with the ablation findings. Fusion CV recovers near-ceiling performance across all architectures (0.9173, 0.9369, 0.9356), with notably lower FPR@80%TPR (0.1237, 0.0872, 0.0700). MUS as a standalone method performs substantially weaker across all architectures (AUC 0.6415-0.7171), with Spearman correlations against Brier score declining from 0.3918 (EfficientNet-B4) to 0.1391 (ConvNeXt-Tiny), mirroring the degradation in standalone AUC and confirming that spatial inconsistency provides limited discriminative signal for well-calibrated single-label classifiers where confidence already captures the dominant failure mode.
paragraphs.zh: 表28报告了三种架构在ImageNet-1k上故障检测的完整次要指标。 Confidence-inv是主导的独立信号，在EfficientNet-B4、ViT-B/16和ConvNeXt-Tiny上的AUC分别达到0.9132、0.9233和0.9131，与消融研究结果一致。 Fusion CV在所有架构上均恢复了接近上限的性能（0.9173、0.9369、0.9356），且FPR@80%TPR显著更低（0.1237、0.0872、0.0700）。 MUS作为独立方法在所有架构上的表现明显更弱（AUC为0.6415-0.7171），其与Brier得分的Spearman相关性从EfficientNet-B4的0.3918下降至ConvNeXt-Tiny的0.1391，这反映了其独立AUC的下降，并证实了空间不一致性对于经过良好校准的单标签分类器而言提供的区分信号有限，因为置信度已经捕捉到了主要的故障模式。

paragraphs.en: Table 29 reports failure detection metrics for Faster R-CNN and RetinaNet on MS COCO 2014 ( N = 5,000 N=5,000 , failure defined as multi-label Brier exceeding the 75th percentile). Entropy is the dominant standalone signal for both detectors (AUC of 0.8839 0.8839 and 0.9121 0.9121 ), while Confidence -1 performs substantially weaker ( 0.6017 0.6017 and 0.7015 0.7015 ), inverting the pattern observed on ImageNet. MUS achieves moderate standalone AUC ( 0.8003 0.8003 and 0.7469 0.7469 ), with Spearman correlations of 0.6133 0.6133 and 0.5095 0.5095 ( p < 10 − 6 p<10^{-6} ) confirming meaningful alignment with Brier-based failure considerably stronger than in the single-label setting. Fusion CV matches or marginally exceeds entropy alone ( 0.8851 0.8851 and 0.9133 0.9133 ), with MUS providing the primary complementary contribution, particularly for RetinaNet. Near-zero crop rates ( 0.002 0.002 and 0.001 0.001 ) confirm adequate detection coverage for MUS computation across both architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 表29报告了Faster R-CNN和RetinaNet在MS COCO 2014数据集上的故障检测指标（N = 5,000 N=5,000，其中“故障”定义为多标签Brier分数超过第75百分位数的情况）。 对于两种检测器而言，熵是主导的独立信号（AUC分别为0.8839 0.8839和0.9121 0.9121），而“置信度-1”的表现则明显更弱（0.6017 0.6017和0.7015 0.7015），这与在ImageNet上观察到的模式相反。 MUS实现了中等水平的独立AUC（0.8003 0.8003和0.7469 0.7469），其Spearman相关系数分别为0.6133 0.6133和0.5095 0.5095（p < 10⁻⁶ p<10⁻⁶），证实了其与基于Brier分数的故障指标存在有意义的关联，且这种关联在单标签设置中明显更弱。 融合CV的结果与单独使用熵的结果一致或略高于后者（0.8851 0.8851和0.9133 0.9133），其中MUS提供了主要的补充贡献，尤其是在RetinaNet中表现突出。 接近零的裁剪率（0.002 0.002和0.001 0.001）证实了MUS在两种架构上的计算均具有充分的检测覆盖范围。
