paragraphs.en: Figure 9 shows MUS Discriminability as a Function of Lesion Spatial Extent (NIH ChestX-ray14, DenseNet-121). (Left) Per-class JSD AUC for failure detection plotted against approximate ordinal lesion size rank, where rank 1 corresponds to the most spatially localized pathologies (Nodule, Mass) and rank 6 to the most spatially diffuse (Pneumonia, Edema). Diffuse pathologies cluster at high JSD AUC (group mean of 0.944, shown in the right panel), while localized lesions cluster at low JSD AUC (group mean of 0.603). The Pearson correlation across all 14 classes is r = 0.306 (p = 0.288); the non-significant p-value reflects the bimodal rather than linear structure of the relationship the two groups are well separated but the within-group variance is high. (Right) Group-level bar chart with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals confirming the diffuse vs. localized split. This analysis directly motivates the multi-scale extension in Appendix H . Since the primary five-crop decomposition operates at 112×112 pixel resolution, pathologies smaller than approximately 3 cm in diameter at standard acquisition resolution fall below the crop resolution limit, explaining the low Nodule AUC (0.368). The multi-scale extension partially recovers performance for small focal lesions (Nodule: 0.368 → 0.589 AUC, Appendix H ).

paragraphs.en: Figure 10 shows MUS Performance vs. Disease Prevalence (NIH ChestX-ray14, DenseNet-121). Per-class JSD AUC for failure detection plotted against test-set prevalence (%), ranging from Hernia (0.34%) to Infiltration (23.9%). The near-zero Pearson correlation (r = 0.112, p = 0.702) confirms that MUS discriminability is not confounded by class frequency or label imbalance. This rules out the alternative explanation that commonly occurring classes benefit from better model calibration, which could artificially inflate uncertainty discrimination for frequent classes. The wide performance variation across classes of similar prevalence for example, Pneumothorax (10.4% prevalence, JSD AUC = 0.894) vs. Emphysema (4.3% prevalence, JSD AUC = 0.670) confirms that lesion morphology and spatial extent, not dataset statistics, drive MUS discriminability. Rare classes such as Hernia (0.34%) and Pneumonia (2.2%) span both extremes of JSD AUC (0.884 and 0.979 respectively), further confirming the prevalence-independence of MUS performance.
paragraphs.zh: 图10展示了MUS性能与疾病患病率之间的关系（NIH ChestX-ray14数据集，DenseNet-121模型）。将失败检测的每类JSD AUC值与测试集患病率（%）进行对比，患病率范围从疝气（0.34%）到浸润（23.9%）。接近零的皮尔逊相关系数（r = 0.112，p = 0.702）证实，MUS的区分能力并未受到类别频率或标签不平衡的影响。这排除了另一种可能的解释：即常见类别可能因模型校准效果更佳而受益，从而人为地夸大了这些常见类别的不确定性区分能力。例如，在患病率相近的不同类别中，表现存在显著差异：气胸（患病率10.4%，JSD AUC = 0.894）与肺大泡（患病率4.3%，JSD AUC = 0.670）。这一现象进一步证实，MUS的区分能力取决于病变形态和空间范围，而非数据集的统计特性。罕见类别如疝气（0.34%）和肺炎（2.2%）的JSD AUC值分别覆盖了0.884和0.979这两个极端值，进一步验证了MUS性能与患病率无关的特性。

paragraphs.en: Table 31 reports the multi-scale MUS extension for Nodule failure detection on NIH DenseNet-121. The baseline five-crop coarse decomposition achieves per-class JSD AUC of 0.3680 for Nodule below chance. A 16-crop fine-grained grid ( 56 × 56 56\times 56 patches, covering the full image at finer resolution) partially recovers performance.
paragraphs.zh: 表 31 报告了基于 NIH DenseNet-121 的结节失败检测的多尺度 MUS 扩展结果。 基线五裁剪粗粒度分解在结节检测中每类的 JSD AUC 仅为 0.3680，低于随机水平。 一种 16 裁剪细粒度网格（56×56 个补丁，以更高分辨率覆盖整张图像）部分恢复了性能。

sents.en: Table 31 reports the multi-scale MUS extension for Nodule failure detection on NIH DenseNet-121.
sents.zh: 表 31 报告了基于 NIH DenseNet-121 的结节失败检测的多尺度 MUS 扩展结果。

sents.en: The baseline five-crop coarse decomposition achieves per-class JSD AUC of 0.3680 for Nodule below chance.
sents.zh: 基线五裁剪粗粒度分解在结节检测中每类的 JSD AUC 仅为 0.3680，低于随机水平。

sents.en: A 16-crop fine-grained grid ( 56 × 56 56\times 56 patches, covering the full image at finer resolution) partially recovers performance.
sents.zh: 一种 16 裁剪细粒度网格（56×56 个补丁，以更高分辨率覆盖整张图像）部分恢复了性能。

paragraphs.en: The fine-grid MUS score (0.589) substantially outperforms the coarse baseline (0.368). The multi-scale average (0.495) is lower because averaging with the weak coarse score dilutes the signal; therefore, we report the fine MUS as the primary multi-scale result throughout the paper. The remaining gap relative to diffuse pathology performance (0.85–0.98) reflects the inherent resolution limit of small focal lesion detection at standard imaging resolutions. This improvement confirms that the limitation is geometric five 112 × 112 112\times 112 crops cannot resolve nodules smaller than 3 cm rather than fundamental. The multi-scale MUS approach (using a 4×4 grid of 56×56 crops) is not adopted as the primary method due to its 16 - pass overhead; instead, it is presented as a direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 细网格 MUS 分数（0.589）显著优于粗基准模型（0.368）。 多尺度平均值（0.495）较低，因为与较弱的粗分数进行平均会削弱信号；因此，我们在整篇论文中都将细网格 MUS 作为主要多尺度结果报告。 与弥漫性病理表现（0.85–0.98）相比，剩余的差距反映了在标准成像分辨率下检测小局灶性病变时固有的分辨率限制。 这一改进证实了该限制是几何性的：五个 112 × 112 的裁剪区域无法分辨小于 3 厘米的结节，而非根本性的限制。 多尺度 MUS 方法（使用由 56×56 裁剪区域组成的 4×4 网格）因其 16 次迭代的额外开销而未被采用为主要方法；相反，它被提出作为未来工作的一个方向。

paragraphs.en: Table 33 reports selective prediction performance for NIH DenseNet-121 using MUS as the referral score. At a 10% recall budget, MUS refers only 4.3% of the test set (1,091 images) with a precision of 58.7%, catching 640 failures demonstrating that a small, targeted referral volume captures a disproportionate share of model errors. Precision degrades modestly as recall increases (54.5% at 20%, 51.4% at 30%), reflecting the expected precision recall trade-off under a fixed failure distribution. Backbone AUC improves monotonically with referral rate, from + 0.0017 +0.0017 at 5% to + 0.0092 +0.0092 at 30% (baseline AUC = 0.8080 =0.8080 ), confirming that selectively abstaining on high-uncertainty predictions yields measurable downstream classification improvement. As we can see from Figure 11 for Pneumothorax specifically , rejecting the top 10% most uncertain images improves class AUC from 0.8471 0.8471 to 0.8495 0.8495 ( + 0.0023 +0.0023 ), with further gains at 20% rejection ( 0.8503 , + 0.0031 0.8503,+0.0031 ), illustrating that MUS-guided deferral provides clinically meaningful improvement even for already well-performing classes.
paragraphs.zh: 表33报告了使用MUS作为转诊分数时，NIH DenseNet-121的选择性预测性能。 在10%的召回预算下，MUS仅对测试集（1,091张图像）中的4.3%进行转诊，精确率为58.7%，成功识别出640个错误，这表明少量有针对性的转诊能够覆盖不成比例的大量模型错误。 随着召回率的提高，精确率略有下降（20%时为54.5%，30%时为51.4%），这反映了在固定错误分布下预期的精确率-召回率权衡关系。 随着转诊率的增长，主干网络AUC持续单调提升：从5%时的+0.0017到30%时的+0.0092（基线AUC = 0.8080），这证实了对高不确定性预测结果进行选择性拒绝能够带来可量化的下游分类性能提升。 从图11中针对气胸的具体分析可以看出，拒绝不确定性最高的前10%图像可将类别AUC从0.8471提升至0.8495（+0.0023），在20%的拒绝率下进一步提升至0.8503（+0.0031），这表明由MUS指导的转诊机制即使对于原本表现良好的类别，也能带来具有临床意义的性能提升。

paragraphs.en: To operationalise selective prediction in a clinically realistic setting, we evaluate both a validation-calibrated 95%-sensitivity threshold (ensuring no more than 5% of diseased images are missed) and direct MUS-ranked referral at fixed recall levels.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在具有临床现实性的环境中实现选择性预测，我们评估了两种方法：一种是通过验证校准得到的95%灵敏度阈值（确保漏诊的疾病图像不超过5%），另一种是在固定召回率水平下直接根据MUS排名进行转诊。

paragraphs.en: Under MUS-ranked referral, the NIH DenseNet-121 backbone achieves the most favourable profile: referring the 2,349 highest-MUS images (9.2% of 25,596) recovers 20% of Brier-defined failures at 54.5% referral precision.
paragraphs.zh: 在 MUS 排名转诊机制下，NIH DenseNet-121 主干网络实现了最理想的性能组合：通过转诊 MUS 值最高的 2,349 张图像（占 25,596 张的 9.2%），可在 54.5% 的转诊精确率下，识别出 20% 的 Brier 定义失败案例。

paragraphs.en: EfficientNet-B4 (threshold = 0.0801 =0.0801 ) refers 97.7% of images under the same 95%-sensitivity rule (only a 2.3% workload reduction) at a false negative rate of 0.93%, reflecting its narrower uncertainty spread relative to DenseNet-121.
paragraphs.zh: EfficientNet-B4（阈值 = 0.0801 =0.0801）在相同的95%灵敏度规则下覆盖了97.7%的图像（工作量仅减少2.3%），其假阴性率为0.93%，这表明与DenseNet-121相比，其不确定性分布更为集中。

paragraphs.en: ViT-B/16 (threshold = 0.0782 =0.0782 ) refers 96.4% of images (a 3.6% workload reduction [3.4%, 3.9%]) at a false negative rate of 1.22%. The validation-calibrated threshold thus maintains 95% sensitivity but barely reduces workload on EfficientNet-B4 and ViT-B/16; the MUS-ranked referral above is the practically useful operating point.
paragraphs.zh: ViT-B/16（阈值 = 0.0782 =0.0782）对 96.4% 的图像进行了判断（工作量减少了 3.6% [3.4%, 3.9%]），其假阴性率为 1.22%。 因此，经过验证校准的阈值虽然保持了 95% 的灵敏度，但对 EfficientNet-B4 和 ViT-B/16 的工作量几乎没有减少；上述按 MUS 排序的转诊结果才是实际可用的工作点。

sents.en: ViT-B/16 (threshold = 0.0782 =0.0782 ) refers 96.4% of images (a 3.6% workload reduction [3.4%, 3.9%]) at a false negative rate of 1.22%.

The validation-calibrated threshold thus maintains 95% sensitivity but barely reduces workload on EfficientNet-B4 and ViT-B/16; the MUS-ranked referral above is the practically useful operating point.

paragraphs.en: Table 34 reports MUS failure detection AUC stratified by age group and gender for DenseNet-121 on the NIH test set ( N = 25,596 N=25,596 ). Gender parity is near-perfect (female 0.7838 0.7838 vs. male 0.7837 0.7837 ), indicating no sex-based bias in spatial uncertainty estimation. Age-stratified results reveal a modest performance gradient, with MUS AUC highest for patients under 40 ( 0.8199 0.8199 ) and declining with age ( 0.7512 0.7512 for age 60-80). We attribute this to two compounding factors: older patients exhibit higher rates of comorbid findings, producing genuinely ambiguous multi-label images where spatial inconsistency is a noisier failure signal; and the NIH training distribution skews toward middle-aged presentations, potentially yielding better-calibrated predictions for younger patients.
paragraphs.zh: 表34报告了DenseNet-121在NIH测试集（N = 25,596 N=25,596）上按年龄组和性别分层的MUS故障检测AUC。 性别平衡近乎完美（女性0.7838 0.7838 vs. 男性0.7837 0.7837），表明空间不确定性估计中不存在基于性别的偏见。 按年龄分层的结果显示存在轻微的性能梯度，其中MUS AUC在40岁以下患者中最高（0.8199 0.8199），并随年龄增长而下降（60-80岁年龄组为0.7512 0.7512）。 我们将此归因于两个相互叠加的因素：老年患者表现出更高的合并症发现率，从而产生真正具有模糊性的多标签图像，其中空间不一致性成为一种更嘈杂的故障信号；此外，NIH训练分布偏向中年表现，这可能导致对年轻患者的预测校准效果更佳。

paragraphs.en: Table 35 reports the corresponding audit for EfficientNet-B4, which exhibits a markedly different age-stratified profile: MUS AUC increases with age ( 0.7723 0.7723 for age < 40 <40 vs. 0.7943 0.7943 for age 60-80), inverting the gradient observed for DenseNet-121. Gender disparity remains negligible (female 0.7813 0.7813 vs. male 0.7863 0.7863 ). paragraphs.en: MUS exploits a fundamental property of neural classifiers under uncertainty. When a model has confidently localized discriminative features, its predictions remain stable across spatial sub-regions: the full image and any crop partially containing those features will yield broadly similar output distributions, producing low JSD. When no such anchoring evidence exists due to low image quality, atypical presentation, or distributional mismatch small changes in the spatial field of view produce large distributional shifts, yielding high JSD. This makes spatial inconsistency a more principled signal than predictive entropy: entropy reflects output-level uncertainty but cannot distinguish genuine label ambiguity from a complete absence of evidence. MUS specifically measures whether a model’s confidence is spatially reproducible a property that entropy is blind to. This mechanism holds consistently across model families. Spearman correlations between MUS and per-image Brier score on NIH are ρ = 0.52 \rho=0.52 (DenseNet-121), ρ = 0.41 \rho=0.41 (EfficientNet-B4), and ρ = 0.44 \rho=0.44 (ViT-B/16), all significant at p < 10 − 6 p<10^{-6} . The modest drop from DenseNet to EfficientNet and ViT is consistent with their more spatially coherent feature representations, which compress the dynamic range of MUS as discussed in Section 6 Score calibration further supports practical deployment: MUS achieves SCE of 0.04-0.08 across architectures, substantially better than most competing methods (Table 1 ), confirming that MUS scores align closely with actual failure rates rather than producing well-ranked but poorly-scaled uncertainty estimates.
paragraphs.zh: MUS 利用了神经分类器在不确定性条件下的一项基本特性。 当模型能够自信地定位出具有区分性的特征时，其预测结果在不同空间子区域中保持稳定：完整图像以及部分包含这些特征的任意裁剪图像，都会产生大致相似的输出分布，从而得到较低的 JSD。 当由于图像质量低、呈现方式异常或分布不匹配而缺乏此类锚定证据时，空间视场中的微小变化会导致较大的分布偏移，从而产生较高的 JSD。 这使得空间不一致性成为比预测熵更具理论依据的信号：熵反映的是输出层的不确定性，但无法区分真正的标签模糊性与完全缺乏证据的情况。 MUS 专门衡量模型的置信度是否在空间上具有可重复性——这是熵所无法察觉的一项特性。 这种机制在不同模型家族中均保持一致。 在 NIH 数据集上，MUS 与每张图像的 Brier 分数之间的 Spearman 相关系数分别为 ρ = 0.52（DenseNet-121）、ρ = 0.41（EfficientNet-B4）和 ρ = 0.44（ViT-B/16），所有结果均在 p < 10^{-6} 的显著性水平上成立。 从 DenseNet 到 EfficientNet 和 ViT 的相关系数略有下降，这与它们更具空间一致性的特征表示相符，这些表示压缩了 MUS 的动态范围（如第 6 节“分数校准”中所述）。这进一步支持了其实际部署的可行性：MUS 在不同架构上的 SCE 均达到 0.04-0.08，显著优于大多数竞争方法（表 1），证实了 MUS 分数与实际的失败率高度一致，而非产生排名良好但尺度失真的不确定性估计。

paragraphs.en: Figure 12 shows Spatial Disagreement Heatmaps. Each panel shows a chest X-ray paired with its normalized per-crop JSD inconsistency map (color scale: black = low, yellow = high). On top row (High MUS), two images with MUS = 0.022 and 0.024 display strong spatial variation across quadrant crops, with particularly high disagreement localised to upper lung regions consistent with diffuse pathologies whose spatial extent changes meaningfully across crops. On bottom row (Low MUS), two images with MUS = 0.001 show uniformly low JSD across all crop positions, reflecting spatially stable model predictions regardless of field of view. The heatmaps provide interpretable spatial grounding for the scalar MUS score.
paragraphs.zh: 图 12 展示了空间分歧热图。 每个子图展示了一张胸部 X 光片及其对应的归一化每裁剪区域 JSD 不一致性地图（颜色标度：黑色 = 低，黄色 = 高）。 在顶部一行（高 MUS）中，MUS 值分别为 0.022 和 0.024 的两张图像显示出各象限裁剪区域间显著的空间变化，分歧程度特别高的区域集中在肺部上部，这与弥漫性病变相符，且这些病变的空间范围在不同裁剪区域间有明显差异。 在底部一行（低 MUS）中，MUS 值均为 0.001 的两张图像显示所有裁剪位置上的 JSD 均一致地处于较低水平，反映出模型预测结果无论视野如何变化都具有空间稳定性。 这些热图为标量 MUS 分数提供了可解释的空间依据。

paragraphs.en: Figure 13 provides mechanistic validation for SpatialUQ via Grad-CAM attribution maps. High-MUS cases (red border; MUS = 0.022-0.024) consistently exhibit anatomically diffuse or mislocalized attributions, with activations concentrated outside the lung parenchyma, signifying a failure to anchor to discriminative features. Conversely, low-MUS cases (blue border; MUS ≈ \approx 0) show compact, plausible attributions localized to expected pathology regions. This correlation between spatial inconsistency and attribution diffusion suggests that high MUS identifies instances where the model relies on spurious or non-specific features, whereas spatial consistency reflects the utilization of localized, interpretable features.
paragraphs.zh: 图 13 通过 Grad-CAM 归因图对 SpatialUQ 的机制进行了验证。 高 MUS 病例（红色边框；MUS = 0.022-0.024）始终表现出解剖学上弥散或定位错误的归因，激活区域集中在肺实质之外，表明模型未能锚定到具有区分性的特征。 相反，低 MUS 病例（蓝色边框；MUS ≈ \approx 0）显示出紧凑且合理的归因，定位在预期的病理区域。 这种空间不一致性与归因弥散之间的相关性表明，高 MUS 可识别模型依赖虚假或非特异性特征的实例，而空间一致性则反映了模型对局部化、可解释特征的有效利用。

sents.zh: 图 13 通过 Grad-CAM 归因图对 SpatialUQ 的机制进行了验证。

sents.en: High-MUS cases (red border; MUS = 0.022-0.024) consistently exhibit anatomically diffuse or mislocalized attributions, with activations concentrated outside the lung parenchyma, signifying a failure to anchor to discriminative features.
sents.zh: 高 MUS 病例（红色边框；MUS = 0.022-0.024）始终表现出解剖学上弥散或定位错误的归因，激活区域集中在肺实质之外，表明模型未能锚定到具有区分性的特征。

sents.en: Conversely, low-MUS cases (blue border; MUS ≈ \approx 0) show compact, plausible attributions localized to expected pathology regions.
sents.zh: 相反，低 MUS 病例（蓝色边框；MUS ≈ \approx 0）显示出紧凑且合理的归因，定位在预期的病理区域。

sents.en: This correlation between spatial inconsistency and attribution diffusion suggests that high MUS identifies instances where the model relies on spurious or non-specific features, whereas spatial consistency reflects the utilization of localized, interpretable features.
sents.zh: 这种空间不一致性与归因弥散之间的相关性表明，高 MUS 可识别模型依赖虚假或非特异性特征的实例，而空间一致性则反映了模型对局部化、可解释特征的有效利用。

paragraphs.en: MUS outperforms MC-Dropout in 4 of 5 settings: NIH DenseNet (+0.119 AUC), EfficientNet (+0.249), ViT (+0.100), CheXpert (+0.109), all p < 10 − 6 p<10^{-6} . The sole exception is VinBigData ( − 0.150 -0.150 AUC), where parameter-space stochasticity captures epistemic uncertainty under extreme distribution shift more reliably than spatial consistency. MC-Dropout’s primary disadvantage, 5 × \times the inference passes of MUS (30 vs. 6), and requirement for training-time dropout layers are entirely avoided by MUS.
paragraphs.zh: 在 5 种设置中，MUS 的表现优于 MC-Dropout：NIH DenseNet（+0.119 AUC）、EfficientNet（+0.249）、ViT（+0.100）和 CheXpert（+0.109），所有 p 值均 < 10⁻⁶。 唯一例外是 VinBigData（−0.150 AUC），在该数据集中，参数空间中的随机性比空间一致性更能可靠地捕捉极端分布偏移下的认识论不确定性。 MUS 完全避免了 MC-Dropout 的两个主要缺点：推理步骤数量是 MUS 的 5 倍（30 次对比 6 次），以及训练时需要使用 dropout 层。

sents.zh: 在 5 种设置中，MUS 的表现优于 MC-Dropout：NIH DenseNet（+0.119 AUC）、EfficientNet（+0.249）、ViT（+0.100）和 CheXpert（+0.109），所有 p 值均 < 10⁻⁶。

paragraphs.en: The 5-member DenseNet ensemble achieves 0.813 AUC, outperforming single model MUS (0.784) but below the linear fusion (0.832, Δ = + 0.019 \Delta=+0.019 , p < 10 − 6 p<10^{-6} ). Ensembles require training 4 additional models 5 × \times training cost and storage making MUS + linear fusion a substantially more practical alternative in resource-constrained clinical settings.
paragraphs.zh: 由 5 个模型组成的 DenseNet 集成模型实现了 0.813 的 AUC，优于单一 MUS 模型（0.784），但低于线性融合模型（0.832，Δ = +0.019 \Delta=+0.019，p < 10^{-6}）。 集成模型需要额外训练 4 个模型，其训练成本是单一模型的 5 倍，且存储需求更高，因此在资源受限的临床环境中，MUS 与线性融合的组合方案显然更为实用。

paragraphs.en: Achieves 0.759 AUC on NIH DenseNet (below MUS) but 0.800 AUC on NIH ViT the strongest single-method competitor on ViT. ODIN requires backpropagation through the input for gradient-based perturbation, adding inference overhead and gradient access requirements that MUS does not need.
paragraphs.zh: 在 NIH DenseNet 上实现了 0.759 的 AUC（低于 MUS），但在 NIH ViT 上达到了 0.800 的 AUC，是 ViT 上最强的单一方法竞争者。 ODIN 需要通过输入进行反向传播以实现基于梯度的扰动，这会带来推理开销和梯度访问要求，而这些是 MUS 所不需要的。

paragraphs.en: Both achieve 0.754 AUC on NIH DenseNet in our post-hoc implementation. Both require access to training-set feature distributions and storage of covariance matrices over the full training set ( ∼ \sim 73,891 × \times 1,024 for DenseNet), while MUS has zero storage overhead. The original DDU additionally requires spectral normalization during training; our post-hoc approximation may underperform the full method.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的事后实现中，两者在 NIH DenseNet 上都达到了 0.754 的 AUC。 两者都需要访问训练集的特征分布，并存储整个训练集的协方差矩阵（DenseNet 的情况为 ∼ \sim 73,891 × \times 1,024），而 MUS 则完全没有存储开销。 原始的 DDU 在训练期间还需要进行谱归一化；我们的事后近似方法的表现可能不如完整的方法。

paragraphs.en: MUS achieves 0.784 (DenseNet-121), 0.784 (EfficientNet-B4), and 0.750 (ViT-B/16). The ViT gap reflects global self-attention’s tendency to produce spatially coherent predictions even when incorrect, suppressing the inconsistency gradient. EfficientNet’s compound scaling allocates more processing to fine-grained spatial features, explaining why its Nodule per-class JSD AUC (0.882) dramatically exceeds DenseNet’s (0.368), EfficientNet’s spatial inconsistency is more discriminative precisely where fine-grained resolution matters.
paragraphs.zh: MUS 的准确率分别为 0.784（DenseNet-121）、0.784（EfficientNet-B4）和 0.750（ViT-B/16）。 ViT 的性能差距反映了全局自注意力机制的一种倾向：即使预测结果不正确，它仍倾向于生成空间上连贯的预测，从而抑制了不一致性梯度。 EfficientNet 的复合缩放策略将更多计算资源分配给精细的空间特征，这解释了为何其结节各分类 JSD AUC（0.882）显著高于 DenseNet（0.368）；EfficientNet 的空间不一致性恰恰在精细分辨率至关重要的位置更具区分能力。

sents.zh: MUS 的准确率分别为 0.784（DenseNet-121）、0.784（EfficientNet-B4）和 0.750（ViT-B/16）。

paragraphs.en: Raw entropy achieves AUC = 0.177 on NIH DenseNet significantly below random. The model trained with label smoothing and class-balanced BCE produces moderate entropy across most predictions; failing predictions tend to be overconfident (high probability assigned to wrong class), not uncertain, making entropy anti-correlated with failure in this configuration. This highlights that MUS and entropy are both architecture- and training-procedure-dependent, and that their combination requires care.
paragraphs.zh: 原始熵在 NIH DenseNet 上的 AUC 为 0.177，显著低于随机水平。 使用标签平滑和类别平衡 BCE 训练的模型在大多数预测中产生中等程度的熵；失败的预测往往过于自信（将高概率分配给错误类别），而非不确定，因此在此配置下，熵与失败呈负相关。 这表明 MUS 和熵都依赖于架构和训练过程，并且它们的组合需要谨慎处理。

paragraphs.en: MUS achieves stronger standalone results on COCO (0.800 / 0.747 AUC) than on ImageNet (0.641-0.717 AUC) relative to baselines, reflecting the multi-label detection setting where spatial inconsistency across object classes is more structurally informative than in single-label recognition. Entropy dominates on COCO (0.884 / 0.912), consistent with detection models having better confidence calibration than multi-label medical classifiers.
paragraphs.zh: 与基线模型相比，MUS 在 COCO（AUC 为 0.800 / 0.747）上取得的独立结果优于 ImageNet（AUC 为 0.641-0.717），这反映了多标签检测设定中，不同物体类别之间的空间不一致性比单标签识别更具结构性信息。 在 COCO 上，熵值占主导地位（0.884 / 0.912），这与检测模型在多标签医学分类器中具有更好的置信度校准能力相一致。

sents.zh: 与基线模型相比，MUS 在 COCO（AUC 为 0.800 / 0.747）上取得的独立结果优于 ImageNet（AUC 为 0.641-0.717），这反映了多标签检测设定中，不同物体类别之间的空间不一致性比单标签识别更具结构性信息。

paragraphs.en: MUS requires 6 forward passes per image under torch.no_grad() , all computable in a single batched call. Measured wall - clock time on the NIH test set (25,596 images, batch size 32) for MUS only: DenseNet - 121 ≈ \approx 8 min; EfficientNet - B4 ≈ \approx 10 min; ViT - B/16 ≈ \approx 29 min. For comparison, MC - Dropout (30 passes) required ≈ \approx 39 min, ≈ \approx 51 min, and ≈ \approx 145 min respectively, confirming a consistent 5 × \times wall - clock speedup that mirrors the pass - count reduction. A five - member deep ensemble uses 5 forward passes (one per model) comparable to MUS’s 6 passes at inference but requires 5 × \times the training cost and cannot be applied to a frozen checkpoint without retraining. MUS’s inference cost is therefore competitive with ensembles while offering the decisive advantage of zero retraining.
paragraphs.zh: MUS 在 torch.no_grad() 下每张图像需要 6 次前向传播，所有计算均可在一次批量调用中完成。 仅在 NIH 测试集（25,596 张图像，批量大小 32）上测得的 MUS 实际运行时间：DenseNet - 121 ≈ \approx 8 分钟；EfficientNet - B4 ≈ \approx 10 分钟；ViT - B/16 ≈ \approx 29 分钟。 作为对比，MC - Dropout（30 次传播）分别需要 ≈ \approx 39 分钟、≈ \approx 51 分钟和 ≈ \approx 145 分钟，这证实了其实际运行时间一致提升了 5 倍，与传播次数减少的情况相符。 一个由五个模型组成的深度集成需要 5 次前向传播（每个模型一次），在推理阶段与 MUS 的 6 次传播相当，但其训练成本是 MUS 的 5 倍，并且无法在不重新训练的情况下应用于已冻结的检查点。 因此，MUS 的推理成本与集成方法具有竞争力，同时具备无需重新训练这一决定性优势。

paragraphs.en: The most important near-term extension is validation on MIMIC-CXR (227,835 radiographs, Beth Israel Deaconess), which would enable evaluation under temporal distribution shift, correlation with radiologist confidence scores in structured reports, and intersectional fairness analysis across race, insurance status, and comorbidity burden dimensions not captured by NIH’s age/gender metadata. Our finding that MUS AUC degrades for older patients (0.820 for < < 40 vs. 0.751 for 60–80 years) motivates a more thorough demographic audit on richer clinical metadata. Additional directions include adaptive crop placement via saliency guidance, MUS for transformer-based segmentation models (UNETR, SwinUNETR), and volumetric extension to 3D CT.
paragraphs.zh: 近期最重要的扩展是在 MIMIC-CXR（227,835 张放射图像，来自 Beth Israel Deaconess）上进行验证，这将使我们能够评估模型在时间分布偏移情况下的表现，分析其与结构化报告中放射科医生置信分数的相关性，并开展跨种族、保险状况和合并症负担等 NIH 年龄/性别元数据未涵盖维度的交叉公平性分析。 我们的研究结果表明，MUS AUC 在老年患者中的表现有所下降（<40 岁为 0.820，而 60–80 岁为 0.751），这促使我们对更丰富的临床元数据开展更为彻底的群体特征审查。 其他研究方向包括通过显著性引导实现自适应裁剪定位、将 MUS 应用于基于 Transformer 的分割模型（UNETR、SwinUNETR），以及向 3D CT 进行体素扩展。

paragraphs.en: The NIH ChestX-ray14 dataset contains 14 disease classes. CheXpert contains 14 classes of which 10 overlap with NIH. We map the shared classes directly by name. The four NIH classes absent from CheXpert ( Emphysema , Fibrosis , Pleural_Thickening , Hernia ) are excluded from evaluation on CheXpert. Uncertain labels (U) in CheXpert are treated as negative (U-Zeros policy), consistent with prior work ( Irvin et al., 2019 ) .
paragraphs.zh: NIH ChestX-ray14 数据集包含 14 种疾病类别。 CheXpert 包含 14 个类别，其中 10 个与 NIH 数据集的类别重叠。 我们直接通过名称将共享的类别进行映射。 CheXpert 中不存在于 NIH 数据集的四个类别（Emphysema、Fibrosis、Pleural_Thickening、Hernia）在 CheXpert 上的评估中被排除在外。 CheXpert 中的不确定标签（U）被当作阴性处理（U-Zeros 策略），这与先前的研究（Irvin et al., 2019）保持一致。

sents.zh: NIH ChestX-ray14 数据集包含 14 种疾病类别。

sents.en: CheXpert contains 14 classes of which 10 overlap with NIH.
sents.zh: CheXpert 包含 14 个类别，其中 10 个与 NIH 数据集的类别重叠。

sents.en: We map the shared classes directly by name.
sents.zh: 我们直接通过名称将共享的类别进行映射。

sents.zh: CheXpert 中的不确定标签（U）被当作阴性处理（U-Zeros 策略），这与先前的研究（Irvin et al., 2019）保持一致。

paragraphs.en: VinBigData contains 28 annotated findings. We map the 10 classes that correspond directly to NIH labels: Atelectasis , Cardiomegaly , Consolidation , Effusion , Infiltration , Mass , Nodule , Pleural_Thickening , Pneumothorax , Fibrosis . The four NIH classes absent from VinBigData ( Edema , Pneumonia , Emphysema , Hernia ) are excluded. All VinBigData annotations are radiologist-verified bounding boxes; we convert these to image-level binary labels (positive if any box of that class is present).
